options.D: शाश्वत विकासाकरिता पाण्यावरील कृतीसाठी आंतरराष्ट्रीय जल दशक

questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय D. संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभेने 2018–2028 हे दशक 'शाश्वत विकासासाठी पाण्यावरील कृती' (International Decade for Action on Water for Sustainable Development) म्हणून घोषित केले — पाणी, स्वच्छता आणि SDG एकत्रित करणारे.

questions.text: पर्यावरण व्यवस्थापन प्रणाली (EMS) प्रक्रियेतील पहिला टप्पा कोणता आहे ?

options.C: पर्यावरणीय उद्दिष्ट्ये आणि लक्ष्ये निर्धारित करा

questions.explanation: EMS प्रक्रियेत पहिला टप्पा — पर्याय B. ISO 14001 प्रकारच्या पर्यावरण व्यवस्थापन प्रणालीत सर्वप्रथम पर्यावरणीय धोरण (environmental policy) तयार करणे — उद्दिष्टे व लक्ष्ये ठरवण्यापूर्वी वरिष्ठ व्यवस्थापनाची लिखित बांधिलकी.

questions.text: महाराष्ट्राच्या उत्तर सीमेलगत खालीलपैकी कोणती पर्वतरांग आहे ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. सातपुडा पर्वतरांग महाराष्ट्राच्या उत्तर सीमेवर पूर्व–पश्चिम दिशेने पसरलेली आहे. हरिश्चंद्र-बालाघाट व महादेव रांगा त्यापेक्षा दक्षिणेकडे डेक्कन पठारावर आहेत.

questions.text:
दाट अथवा केंद्रित वसाहतीची खालीलप्रमाणे वैशिष्ट्ये आहेत.
अ. मैदानी भागात तसेच सुपीक मृदेच्या भागात भारतात दाट वसाहती आढळतात.
ब. वसाहती दाट असल्यामुळे अस्वच्छता, सामाजिक तंटे, आरोग्याचे प्रश्न इत्यादी नकारात्मक बाबीही तेथे निर्माण होऊ शकतात.
क. या वसाहतीमध्ये घरांची रचना ही वर्तुळाकार स्वरूपाची असते.
ड. डोंगराळ भागात, दाट जंगलात आणि वाळवंटी प्रदेश येथे अशा प्रकारची वस्ती आढळते.
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान / विधाने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय B. दाट वसाहती सुपीक मैदानी भागात (अ) आणि गर्दीमुळे स्वच्छता व आरोग्याचे प्रश्न (ब) — ही मुख्य वैशिष्ट्ये आहेत. अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेनुसार (ड) देखील यात मोजले आहे; दाट व विखुरलेली वसाहती एकत्र पुनरावृत्ती करा.

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्रातील पठारावर अनेक डोंगर रांगा पसरल्या आहेत त्यांचा उत्तरेकडून दक्षिणेकडे असा क्रम लावा.
अ. सातपुडा रांग
ब. हरिश्चंद्र बालाघाट रांग
क. महादेव डोंगर रांग
ड. सातमाळा-अजिंठा डोंगर रांग
questions.explanation: योग्य क्रम — पर्याय B. महाराष्ट्र पठारावर उत्तरेकडून दक्षिणेकडे: सातपुडा (अ) → सातमाळा-अजिंठा (ड) → हरिश्चंद्र-बालाघाट (ब) → महादेव रांग (क). नकाशावर एकदा लावला की लक्षात राहतो.

questions.text: जेव्हा किरणोत्सर्गी पदार्थातून बाहेर पडणारे उत्सर्जन चुंबकीय क्षेत्रातून मार्गक्रमण करते तेव्हा खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान खरे ठरते ?

options.A: बाहेर पडणारे सर्वच उत्सर्जित किरण एकाच दिशेने वळलेले दिसतात
options.B: बाहेर पडणाऱ्या उत्सर्जित किरणांवर कोणताही फरक पडत नाही
options.C: बाहेर पडणारे किरण तीन भागात विभागले जातील व त्यांचा मार्ग यादृच्छिक (रँडम) असेल
options.D: बाहेर पडणारे किरण तीन वेगवेगळ्या भागात विभागले जाऊन, त्यापैकी दोन एकमेकांच्या विरुद्ध दिशांना वळतील तर तिसरा भाग हा अविचलित (undeflected) राहील

questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय D. किरणोत्सर्गी उत्सर्जन चुंबकीय क्षेत्रात तीन भागात विभागते: α-कण एका दिशेने, β-कण विरुद्ध दिशेने वळतात, तर γ-किरणे सरळ जातात — अविचलित.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणता गॅमा किरणांचा गुणधर्म आहे ?

options.A: यामध्ये दोन एकक धन भार असतो
options.B: बीटा किरणांपेक्षा आयनिकीकरण शक्ती 100 पट जास्त असते
options.C: त्यांच्यावर विद्युत आणि चुंबकीय क्षेत्राचा प्रभाव पडत नाही

questions.explanation: विश्लेषण — पर्याय C. गॅमा किरणे हे विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग असून त्यांना कोणताही भार नसतो, म्हणून विद्युत किंवा चुंबकीय क्षेत्र त्यांना वळवू शकत नाही. α ला +2 आणि β ला −1 भार असतो.

questions.text:
भौतिक राशी आणि त्यांचे एकक यांच्या जोड्या लावा.
i. लांबी
ii. वस्तुमान
iii. वेळ
iv. तापमान
A. सेकंद
B. सेंटीमीटर
C. ग्रॅम
D. केल्विन
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय D. लांबी–सेंटीमीटर (B), वस्तुमान–ग्रॅम (C), वेळ–सेकंद (A), तापमान–केल्विन (D) — म्हणजे क्रम B, C, A, D.

questions.text:
“तुरटी” जी जलशुद्धीकरणासाठी वापरली जाते, त्यात खालीलपैकी कोणत्या मूलद्रव्याचे वस्तुमानानुसार सर्वाधिक प्रमाण असते ?
( अणूभार : O = 16, Al = 27, S = 32, K = 39)
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय C. पोटॅश alum KAl(SO₄)₂·12H₂O मध्ये 20 ऑक्सिजन अणू (~474 पैकी 320 वस्तुमान) असल्याने ऑक्सिजनचे वस्तुमान प्रमाण सर्वाधिक — K, Al, S पेक्षा खूप जास्त.

questions.text:
आधुनिक आवर्त सारणीमध्ये, डावीकडून उजवीकडे जाताना, दुसऱ्या आवर्तात लिथियम पासून फ्लोरिन पर्यंत मूलद्रव्यांची अणु त्रिज्या _________.
अ. वाढत जाते
ब. कमी होत जाते
क. सुरुवातीला कमी होत जाते नंतर वाढते
ड. स्थिर राहते

options.A: फक्त ड आणि क चुकीचे आहेत

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय C. दुसऱ्या आवर्तात Li ते F डावीकडून उजवीकडे जाताना अणुकेंद्राचा प्रभार वाढते, इलेktron तेच shell मध्ये — अणु त्रिज्या सातत्याने कमी होते; फक्त विधान ब बरोबर.

questions.text: ओझोन स्तराच्या कमी होण्याचे मुख्य कारण काय आहे ?
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय B. CFC (क्लोरोफ्लोरोकार्बन) stratosphere मध्ये chlorine मुक्त करून ozone अणूंचे विघटन करतात — ओझोन छिद्राचे मुख्य मानवी कारण. CO₂ warming साठी; थेट ozone नष्टीसाठी नाही.

questions.text: सरपटणाऱ्या/सरीसृप प्राणीवर्गाच्या खालील प्राण्यांपैकी जिवंत जीवाश्म कोणते ?
questions.explanation: उत्तर — पर्याय D. Sphenodon (tuatara) हा 'जिवंत जीवाश्म' — Mesozoic काळापासून जवळजवळ अपरिवर्तित. Hemidactylus, Chameleon, Draco सारख्या सामान्य सरपटणाऱ्या प्राण्यांपेक्षा वेगळा.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणते प्राणी एकाच जातीचे आहेत ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Octopus, Pila आणि Sepia — तीनही Phylum Mollusca (मोलस्का) चे. Asterias (Echinodermata) आणि Holothuria (Echinodermata) वेगळ्या phylum चे.

questions.text: खालील शास्त्रज्ञांपैकी कोणास 'वर्गीकरणाचे जनक' असे म्हणतात ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय C. Carolus Linnaeus (Carl von Linné) यांनी द्विनामी नामपद्धती व वैज्ञानिक वर्गीकरणाचा पाया घातला — म्हणून 'वर्गीकरणाचे जनक'. Robert Brown, Lamarck, Hooke यांचे योगदान वेगळे.

questions.text: ____________ ट्रान्सजेनिक वनस्पतीमध्ये तीव्र विषाणू प्रतिकार निर्माण करते.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय A. RNA silencing (RNA interference) ट्रान्सजेनिक वनस्पतीत viral RNA नष्ट करून तीव्र विषाणू प्रतिकार देते — पारंपरिक प्रजनन किंवा संकरणापेक्षा प्रगत biotech पद्धत.

questions.text: __________ हे वनस्पती संप्ररेक जे पाण्याची कमतरता असल्यास स्टोमेटा बंद करते.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. पाण्याची कमतरता असताना अबसीसीक ॲसिड (ABA) हे संप्रेरक स्टोमेटा बंद करण्याचा संकेत देतो, ज्यामुळे वाष्पोत्सर्जन कमी होते. ऑक्सिन्स आणि जिबरेलिन्स वाढीशी संबंधित असतात; दुष्काळात स्टोमेटा बंद करण्याचे काम ABA चे असते.

questions.text:
वर्गीकरणाचा पदानुक्रम लावा.
अ. गण
ब. वर्ग
क. प्रजाती
ड. कुल
questions.explanation: योग्य पर्याय C आहे. वर्गीकरणाच्या पदानुक्रमात वर्ग, नंतर गण, कुल आणि शेवटी प्रजाती येतात — म्हणजे ब → अ → ड → क. वर्ग → गण → कुल → प्रजाती ही मालिका लक्षात ठेवा.

questions.text: भारतातील हवाई छायाचित्राचे आदर्श प्रमाण कोणते आहे ?
questions.explanation: आयोगाने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला आहे (अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेत '#' चिन्ह). भारतातील हवाई छायाचित्र प्रमाण या विषयावरील हा प्रश्न गुणांसाठी मोजला जात नाही.

questions.text: जर तुम्ही दुष्काळ परिस्थितीचा वनस्पतींवर होणाऱ्या परिणामांचा अभ्यास करत असाल तर विद्युतचुंबकीय वर्णपटातील कोणता भाग सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त डेटा प्रदान करू शकतो ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. निरोगी वनस्पती जवळील अवरक्त विकिरण चांगले परावर्तित करते, म्हणून दुष्काळग्रस्त किंवा कमी वनस्पती आच्छादन या भागात स्पष्ट दिसते. उष्ण आणि मध्य अवरक्त तापमान व ओलाव्यासाठी अधिक उपयुक्त.

questions.text:
खालील विधानांचा विचार करा.
a. जी. आय. एस. चा उपयोग अवकाशीय विश्लेषणासाठी केला जातो.
b. जी. आय. एस. चा वापर स्रोतापासून पृथ्वीच्या पृष्ठभागावर ऊर्जेच्या संक्रमणासाठी होतो.
c. जी. आय. एस. चा उपयोग डेटा दृश्यमान होण्याकरिता केला जातो.
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे/त ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. जी. आय. एस. अवकाशीय विश्लेषण आणि नकाशावर डेटा दाखवण्यासाठी वापरतात; स्रोतापासून पृथ्वीवर ऊर्जा पोहोचवणे हे GIS चे काम नाही — ते दूरस्थ संवेदनाशी संबंधित आहे.

questions.text: कोणत्या प्रकारच्या हवाई छायाचित्रात संपूर्ण हवाई छायाचित्राचे प्रमाण समान असते ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. लंबरूप हवाई छायाचित्र खाली लक्ष्य करून घेतले जाते, म्हणून संपूर्ण चित्रात प्रमाण जवळजवळ समान राहते. तिरकस छायाचित्रात प्रमाण बदलते.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणते सिंटॅक्स त्रुटी शोधते आणि त्या प्रोग्रामरला रिपोर्ट करते ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. कंपायलर स्रोत कोडमधील सिंटॅक्स त्रुटी — चुकीचे कीवर्ड, सेमिकोलन गहाळ असणे — शोधून प्रोग्रामरला कळवतो. ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टिम हार्डवेअर व्यवस्थापित करते; कोड तपासत नाही.

questions.text: कम्प्यूटर सिस्टिममध्ये सेकंडरी मेमरी का आवश्यक आहे ?

options.A: RAM च्या तुलनेत जलद डेटा ॲक्सेस करण्यासाठी

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. RAM अस्थिर असते — वीज गेल्यावर डेटा नष्ट होतो. सेकंडरी मेमरी (हार्ड डिस्क, SSD) प्रोग्राम आणि फाइल्स कायमस्वरूपी साठवते, म्हणून बंद केल्यावरही डेटा राहतो.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणते क्लाऊड कम्प्युटिंग इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर अ‍ॅज अ सर्व्हिस (IaaS) मॉडेलचे उदाहरण नाही ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. AWS EC2, Azure VM आणि Google Compute Engine व्हर्च्युअल सर्व्हर भाड्याने देतात — हे IaaS आहे. GitHub कोड साठवण आणि सहकार्याचे व्यासपीठ आहे; कच्चे compute infrastructure पुरवत नाही.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणते साधन इनपुट तसेच आउटपुट साधन म्हणून उपयोगात आणले जाते ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. टच स्क्रिन बोटाने इनपुट घेते आणि त्याच पृष्ठभागावर आउटपुट दाखवते. टच पॅड आणि माऊस फक्त इनपुट; CRT फक्त आउटपुट.

questions.text:
खालीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने बरोबर आहेत ?
i. 1969 मध्ये 19 बँकांचे राष्ट्रीयकरण झाले.
ii. 50 कोटी रु. पेक्षा अधिक ठेवी असलेल्या व्यापारी बँकांचे राष्ट्रीयकरण झाले.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. जुलै 1969 मध्ये 50 कोटी रुपयांपेक्षा जास्त ठेवी असलेल्या 14 व्यापारी बँकांचे — 19 नव्हे — राष्ट्रीयकरण झाले. विधान ii हे ठेवीचे मानदंड बरोबर सांगते; विधान i मध्ये संख्या चुकीची आहे.

questions.text: 1951-52 ते 2018-19 या संपूर्ण काळात जवळजवळ 93 ते 94% परदेशी साहाय्य (foreign aid) ______ स्वरूपात भारताला मिळाली आहे.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. 1951-52 ते 2018-19 या काळात भारताला मिळालेल्या परदेशी साहाय्यापैकी सुमारे 93–94% कर्ज स्वरूपात होते, थेट अनुदान नव्हते. साहाय्याचा मुख्य भाग कर्जावर आधारित होता.

questions.text:
आर्थिक सुधारणांसंदर्भातील मूल्यमापनात खालीलपैकी कोणते मुद्दे सुधारणांचे अपयश दर्शवतात ?
a. रोजगारविहीन वृद्धी
b. वाढती असमानता
c. वाढता आर्थिक विकास दर
d. आरोग्य सुविधांवरील कमी झालेला सार्वजनिक खर्च
खालीलपैकी योग्य पर्याय निवडा.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. रोजगारविहीन वृद्धी, वाढती असमानता आणि आरोग्य सुविधांवरील कमी झालेला सार्वजनिक खर्च — हे सुधारणांची अपयशे म्हणून मानले जातात. वाढता विकास दर (c) यश मानले जाते, अपयश नाही.

questions.text: फिशरचा पैशाचे प्रमाण सिद्धांत खालील विनिमयाशी संबंधित कोणते समीकरण स्पष्ट करतो ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. फिशरच्या पैशाच्या प्रमाण सिद्धांताचे मूळ समीकरण MV = PT आहे — पैसा (M), वेग (V), किंमत पातळी (P) आणि व्यवहार (T) यांचा संबंध. इतर पर्याय अयोग्यरित्या मांडलेले आहेत.

questions.text:
मोठ्या प्रमाणावरील आयात (Bulk imports) खालीलपैकी कोणत्या तीन घटकांमध्ये विभागली जाते ?
अ. खनिज तेल, कच्चे तेल आणि उत्पादने इ.
ब. तृणधान्ये आणि कडधान्ये, खाद्यतेल आणि साखर इ. यांचा समावेश असलेल्या मोठ्या प्रमाणातील उपभोग्य वस्तू
क. भांडवली वस्तू, धातू, यंत्र साधने, विद्युत आणि बिगर-विद्युत यंत्रे इ.
ड. खते, बिगर-लोह धातू, कागद आणि कागदी फलक, लोखंड आणि पोलाद इ.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. मोठ्या प्रमाणातील आयात तीन भागांत विभागली जाते: खनिज/कच्चे तेल, मोठ्या प्रमाणातील उपभोग्य वस्तू (तृणधान्ये, कडधान्ये, तेल, साखर) आणि खते, बिगर-लोह धातू, लोखंड-पोलाद. भांडवली वस्तू वेगळ्या श्रेणीत येतात.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणती पत मानांकन संस्था भारतातील सेबीमध्ये नोंदणीकृत नाही ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. Moody's ही अमेरिकेतील जागतिक संस्था आहे आणि भारतात सेबीकडे पत मानांकन संस्था म्हणून नोंदणीकृत नाही. CARE, CRISIL आणि Brickwork Ratings भारतात नोंदणीकृत आहेत.

questions.text: चालू केंद्रीय अर्थसंकल्पात लिंगभावाच्या आधारावर अर्थसंकल्पातील वाटा हा आर्थिक वर्ष 2024-25 मध्ये 6.8% होता. तो आर्थिक वर्ष 2025-26 साठी _______ पर्यंत वाढला आहे.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. केंद्रीय अर्थसंकल्प 2025-26 मध्ये लिंगभाव आधारित अर्थसंकल्पाचा वाटा 6.8% वरून 8.86% पर्यंत वाढला. अशा अर्थसंकल्पातील आकडे चालू घडामोडींसाठी लक्षात ठेवा.

questions.text:
वित्त आयोग आणि त्याचे अध्यक्ष यांची योग्य जोडी लावा.
अ. तेरावा वित्त आयोग
ब. चौदावा वित्त आयोग
क. पंधरावा वित्त आयोग
ड. सोळावा वित्त आयोग
i. अरविंद पांगारिया
ii. एन. के. सिंग
iii. विजय केळकर
iv. वाय. व्ही. रेड्डी
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. 13व्या वित्त आयोगाचे अध्यक्ष विजय केळकर, 14व्या वाय. व्ही. रेड्डी, 15व्या एन. के. सिंग आणि 16व्या अरविंद पांगारिया — म्हणजे अ-iii, ब-iv, क-ii, ड-i.

questions.text:
खालीलपैकी कोणता/ते देश एशियनचा/चे सदस्य नाही/त ?
अ. फिलिपिन्स
ब. कंबोडिया
क. इंडोनेशिया
ड. भारत
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. एशियनमध्ये फिलिपिन्स, कंबोडिया, इंडोनेशिया यासह दहा दक्षिणपूर्व आशियाई देश सदस्य आहेत. भारत सदस्य नाही; तो संवाद भागीदार म्हणून जोडलेला आहे.

questions.text:
नीती आयोग पुरस्कृत स्पर्धात्मक संघराज्यात खालीलपैकी कोणत्या बाबींचा समावेश होत नाही ?
a. राज्यांमध्ये निरोगी स्पर्धा निर्माण होण्यासाठी राज्यांची क्रमवारी ठरवणे.
b. राज्यांचा शालेय आणि आरोग्य निर्देशांक.
c. राज्यांचा निर्यात स्पर्धात्मकता निर्देशांक.
d. सुरक्षा बाजार निर्देशांक.
योग्य उत्तर निवडा.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. नीती आयोगाच्या स्पर्धात्मक संघराज्यात शिक्षण, आरोग्य आणि निर्यात स्पर्धात्मकता निर्देशांकावर राज्यांची क्रमवारी ठरवली जाते. सुरक्षा बाजार निर्देशांक या अंतर्गत येत नाही.

title: Group C Mains 2024 - General Studies & Intelligence Test (Set A)

questions.text:
Suggest the appropriate option in place of question mark.
D 16 N : H 2 S
B 256 M : ?
questions.explanation: Cancelled by the Commission (marked '#' in the official answer key). This item on letter–number analogy coding is not scored.

questions.text: As per following Venn diagram, which subject was taken by the largest number of students ? [The Venn diagram consists of four overlapping circles representing four subjects: History (top), Mathematics (left), Geography (right), and Science (bottom). The numbers in each region are: History only: 16; Mathematics only: 9; Geography only: 9; Science only: 19; Intersection of Math & History: 14; Intersection of History & Geography: 12; Intersection of Math & Science: 15; Intersection of Science & Geography: 16; Intersection of Math, History & Science: 18; Intersection of History, Geography & Science: 18; Intersection of Math, History & Geography: 13; Intersection of Math, Geography & Science: 13; Intersection of all four subjects at the center: 20.]
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Add every region that includes Science — only-Science (19), plus each overlap touching Science — and the total comes to 119, ahead of History (111), Mathematics (102), and Geography (101). In four-set Venns, count each subject by sweeping every zone where its circle appears.

questions.text:
Identify the number that comes in place of the question mark.
2, 12, 30, 56, 90, ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. The gaps between terms grow by 8 each step: 10, 18, 26, 34 — so the next gap is 42 and 90 + 42 = 132. When second differences stay constant, the next term follows by adding that fixed increment to the last gap.

questions.text: Sham is taller than Ram. Ram is taller than Amir. Sudhir is taller than Shishir. Shishir is taller than Ram. Who is shortest among all ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. From the chain — Sham > Ram > Amir and Sudhir > Shishir > Ram — Amir sits below Ram with no one shorter named below him, so Amir is shortest. Line up all five names on one height ladder before picking the extreme.

questions.text: In the given example, study the first three pattern and select what comes in place of question mark. [The figure contains four circles. Each circle has four numbers outside at the top, bottom, left, and right positions, and one number inside the center. Circle 1: Top 3, Left 2, Right 5, Bottom 4; Inside 196. Circle 2: Top 5, Left 1, Right 4, Bottom 3; Inside 169. Circle 3: Top 3, Left 5, Right 5, Bottom 3; Inside 256. Circle 4: Top 7, Left 6, Right 5, Bottom 3; Inside ?]
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. In each circle the four outer numbers sum to a value whose square fills the centre: 14² = 196, 13² = 169, 16² = 256; for 7 + 6 + 5 + 3 = 21, we get 21² = 441. Spot the repeated squaring rule across the first three figures before solving the fourth.

questions.text: A certain amount was to be distributed among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4 respectively, but was erroneously distributed in the ratio 7 : 2 : 5 respectively. As a result of this, B got Rs. 30,000/- less. What is the amount ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. B's correct share is 3/9 of the total and the wrong share is 2/14; the shortfall is (3/9 − 2/14) = 4/21 of the whole amount, and 4/21 × Total = ₹30,000 gives Total = ₹1,57,500. Ratio-error sums always compare each person's correct fraction with what they actually received.

questions.text: Suppose in your watch it is 9 O' clock. If the hours hand is in west direction, then what is the direction of minute hand ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. At 9 o'clock the minute hand sits at 12; if the hour hand at 9 points west, the whole dial is rotated so that the 12-position faces north. Picture the rotated clock face — where 12 sits fixes the minute hand's direction.

questions.text: Pankaj, Kiran and Anil, these three were given Rs. 1,000/- in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5, so how many rupees will come to Kiran's share ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Kiran's ratio part is 3 out of 2 + 3 + 5 = 10, so Kiran gets (3/10) × ₹1,000 = ₹300. In a simple split, one person's share equals their ratio part divided by the total of all parts, times the whole sum.

questions.text: Observe the figures and select an appropriate figure at the place of question mark. [The first part shows a circle and a triangle, followed by a composite figure where the circle is placed on top of the triangle's apex. The second part shows a horizontal rectangle and a vertical rectangle, followed by a question mark.]

options.A: A vertical rectangle placed centrally on top of a horizontal rectangle, forming an inverted 'T' shape
options.B: A vertical rectangle placed on the left end of a horizontal rectangle, forming an 'L' shape
options.C: A vertical rectangle placed on the right end of a horizontal rectangle, forming a mirror-image 'L' shape
options.D: A horizontal rectangle placed centrally on top of a vertical rectangle, forming a standard 'T' shape

questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. The first pair stacks the circle on the triangle's apex; the second pair should stack the horizontal rectangle centrally on top of the vertical one — a standard T shape. Non-verbal analogies repeat the same positional relationship between the two shapes.

questions.text:
1 1/2 ÷ 3 3/5 = ?
Choose correct option from the following.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Convert to fractions: 1½ ÷ 3⅗ = (3/2) ÷ (18/5) = (3/2) × (5/18) = 15/36. Mixed-number division becomes straightforward once both values are written as improper fractions.

questions.text:
Select the correct statement/s from the following :
A. PRERNA – launched its pilot phase from January 15, 2024 to February 17, 2024 at a vernacular school in Vadnagar, Gujrat.
B. The PRERNA is a week-long residential program designed for selected students from class V to VIII.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. PRERNA's pilot did run from 15 January to 17 February 2024 at a vernacular school in Vadnagar, Gujarat; statement B misstates the programme design, so only A holds. Scheme questions often test the exact launch window and pilot location.

questions.text: The 'Sengol' scepter installed in the new building of the Indian Parliament is the symbol of which empire/reign ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. The Sengol sceptre placed in the new Parliament building draws on the Chola tradition of handing over the royal staff as a symbol of just rule and transfer of power. The 2023 installation explicitly linked this ceremony to Chola heritage.

questions.text: The 70th National Film Award best male playback singer has been awarded to Arijit Singh for the song __________.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. At the 70th National Film Awards, Arijit Singh won Best Male Playback Singer for "Kesariya" from Brahmāstra. Film-award PYQs usually pair the artist with the exact song title, not just the film.

questions.text: Paetongtarn Sinvatra, Ex-Prime Minister of Thailand is the leader of which political party ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Paetongtarn Shinawatra, who briefly served as Thailand's Prime Minister in 2024, belongs to the Pheu Thai Party founded by her father Thaksin Shinawatra. Track party names alongside leaders when international appointments appear in the paper.

questions.text: In January 2025 who has been selected as Secretary of Board of Control for Cricket in India ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Devjit Saikia was elected Secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in January 2025, succeeding Jay Shah in that administrative role. BCCI office-bearer changes are regular current-affairs fare for MPSC.

questions.text:
Match the pairs – (Arjuna Award, 2024).
List 'A' (Sports person)
A. Vantika Agrawal
B. Jarmanpreet Singh
C. Abhay Singh
D. Swapnil Kusale
List 'B' (Sports)
i. Shooting
ii. Squash
iii. Hockey
iv. Chess
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Arjuna Award 2024 went to Vantika Agrawal (chess), Jarmanpreet Singh (hockey), Abhay Singh (squash), and Swapnil Kusale (shooting) — matching iv, iii, ii, i. Arjuna lists are tested as sport-to-player pairs, so learn each recipient's discipline.

questions.text: Which day is celebrated as World Happiness Day every year ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The United Nations observes International Day of Happiness on 20 March every year, coinciding with the March equinox. UN observance dates — 20 March for Happiness, 21 June for Yoga — are worth a quick revision list.

questions.text: Lake Victoria is boardered by which of the following countries ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Lake Victoria — Africa's largest lake by area — is bordered by Tanzania, Uganda, and Kenya on its shores. The three-country rim around Victoria is a standard map fact for world-geography questions.

questions.text: India's first glass bridge has been inaugurated in which state ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. India's first glass bridge was inaugurated in Tamil Nadu, adding to the state's list of recent tourism infrastructure headlines. First-in-India landmarks are often framed as state-specific current-affairs items.

questions.text: Who among the following is the recipient of the Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2024 ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Sudha Murthy received the Lokmanya Tilak National Award for 2024, recognising her contributions to social work and literature. Maharashtra-linked national awards frequently feature prominent public figures from the state.

questions.text: Suppose A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20, 30 and 60 days respectively. In how many days A can do the work if he is assisted by B and C on every third day ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. A's rate is 1/20 per day; in each block of three days he works alone on two days (2/20) and all three together on the third (1/20 + 1/30 + 1/60 = 1/10), so one block finishes 1/5 of the work — five such blocks, i.e. 15 days, complete the job. Cycle-based time-and-work sums become quick once you tabulate work done per repeating period.

questions.text: Which of the following is a rational number ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Expanding (√2 + 1/√2)² gives 2 + 2 + 1/2 = 9/2, a ratio of integers, so it is rational; the other options involve √5, √3 or π and stay irrational. Rational-or-irrational items often yield to quick simplification rather than decimal guessing.

questions.text: Number of students from Prakruti Vidyalaya and Sanskruti Vidyalaya appearing in different examinations is given in following bar graph : [Bar graph: Y-axis Number of students 0–35; X-axis English Olympiad, Maths Olympiad, General Knowledge, Debate; Prakruti Vidyalaya (grey): English 20, Maths 10, General Knowledge 25, Debate 10; Sanskruti Vidyalaya (black): English 10, Maths 15, General Knowledge 30, Debate 5] The number of students from Prakruti Vidyalaya appearing in English olympiad examination is how much times the difference of total number of students from two schools appearing in all these examinations ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Prakruti's English Olympiad count is 20; totals for the two schools are 65 and 60, so the difference is 5, and 20 ÷ 5 = 4 times. Read each bar, add school-wise totals first, then compare — the wording is clumsy but the arithmetic is straightforward.

questions.text: The graph below provides data on a Common Entrance Examination CEE conducted in different years. By what percent did the number of questions decrease from CEE 2000 to CEE 2006 ? [Bar graph: Y-axis No. of Questions 10–60; X-axis CEE 2000–CEE 2006; CEE 2000: 55, CEE 2001: 52, CEE 2002: 50, CEE 2003: 48, CEE 2004: 46, CEE 2005: 44, CEE 2006: 40]
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Questions fell from 55 in CEE 2000 to 40 in CEE 2006 — a drop of 15 on the 2000 base, i.e. (15/55) × 100 = 27.27%. Percent decrease always uses the original year as the denominator, not the final count.

questions.text: A number when divided by 5 leaves a remainder 3. What is the remainder when the square of the same number is divided by 5 ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. If n leaves remainder 3 on division by 5, then n = 5k + 3 and n² = 25k² + 30k + 9, which leaves remainder 4 when divided by 5. Remainder patterns for squares modulo small divisors are worth memorising for speed.

questions.text: A farmer has taken a loan of Rs. 20,000. He agreed to return this amount with total interest of Rs. 2,800 in 12 installments. The amount of every installment is less by Rs. 100 than the previous installment. What is the amount of the first installment ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Principal plus interest is ₹22,800 across 12 installments decreasing by ₹100 each; summing an AP gives 12a − 100 × 66 = 22,800, so the first installment a = ₹2,450. Decreasing-installment problems are standard arithmetic-progression sums.

questions.text: The classification of skilled workers is shown in the pie diagram. If the number of workers in the production sector is 450, then the total number of skilled workers working in the construction field will be _________. [Pie diagram: Agri 60°, Production 90°, Construction 72°, Other 138°]
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Production's 90° slice corresponds to 450 workers, so total skilled workers = 450 × (360/90) = 1,800; construction's 72° share is 1,800 × (72/360) = 360. In pie-chart items, one known sector fixes the whole population.

questions.text:
Study the Venn diagram given below.
[Venn diagram: Rectangle (doctors), Triangle (singers), Circle (artists), Square (sports players); Rectangle only: 9; Rectangle and Circle: 12; Rectangle, Circle and Triangle: 4; Rectangle and Triangle: 11; Triangle only: 5; Circle only: 3; Circle and Square: 10; Rectangle, Circle and Square: 6; Square only: 7; Rectangle and Square: 13]
i. Rectangle represents doctors.
ii. Triangle represents singers.
iii. Circle represents artists.
iv. Square represents sports players.
Who among the following is neither a singer nor a sports player but is an artist and a doctor ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. We need doctor ∩ artist, excluding anyone in the singer (triangle) or sports (square) sets — that is exactly the rectangle–circle overlap of 12, not the regions that also touch triangle or square. Venn questions reduce to listing set conditions and picking the labelled region that satisfies all of them.

questions.text: A large solid cube is formed from the metal obtained by melting three smaller solid cubes of 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm side length. What is the ratio of the total surface areas of the smaller cubes and the large cube ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Combined volume 27 + 64 + 125 = 216 cm³ gives a large cube of side 6 cm (surface 216 cm²); the three smaller cubes total 6(9 + 16 + 25) = 300 cm², so the ratio is 300 : 216 = 25 : 18. Melting problems preserve volume but change total surface area — do not equate the two.

questions.text: A train starts with full of passengers. At the first station, it drops one third of the passengers and takes 280 more. At the second station, it drops one half of the new total and takes 12 more. On arriving at the third station, it is found to have 248 passengers. Find the number of passengers in the beginning.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Starting with x passengers: after station 1 there are 2x/3 + 280; halving and adding 12 at station 2 gives x/3 + 152 = 248, so x = 288. Reverse-step passenger problems are easiest when you write the count after each stop.

questions.text: Which of the following number is completely divisible by each of 8, 9, 10, 11 ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Divisibility by 8, 9, 10 and 11 together requires the LCM 3,960; only 47,520 is an exact multiple (47,520 ÷ 3,960 = 12). For combined divisibility, find the LCM of all divisors and test options against it.

questions.text: For m = 2, what is the value of (- 4m)⁻⁴ ÷ (8m)⁻³ ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. With m = 2, (−4m)⁻⁴ ÷ (8m)⁻³ = 16³ ÷ (−8)⁴ = 4096/4096 = 1. Negative-index division flips to positive powers in the numerator — keep track of the base signs separately.

questions.text: As per which of the following Section of the Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015 the procedure for fixing the responsibility on designated officer for repeated failures is given ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Section 12 of the Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015 lays down the procedure for fixing responsibility on the designated officer when services are repeatedly delayed or denied. State service-delivery Acts are high-yield for MPSC — note section numbers alongside key duties.

questions.text: As per S. 6(3) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 where an application is made to public authority requesting for an information which is held by another public authority, the public authority to which such application is made shall transfer the application to that other public authority within the maximum period of __________.

options.A: Seven days from the date of receipt of application
options.B: Five days from the date of receipt of application
options.C: Three working days from the date of receipt of application

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Section 6(3) of the RTI Act, 2005 requires the receiving public authority to transfer an application to the authority that holds the information within five days of receipt. RTI timelines are frequently tested — five days for transfer, thirty for supply (with extensions in defined cases).

questions.text: Which Section explains about the penalties in the Right to Information Act, 2005 ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Section 20 of the RTI Act, 2005 deals with penalties for improper refusal of information, delay without reasonable cause, and related offences by Central Public Information Officers. Pair Section 20 with penalties and Section 19 with the appeal mechanism.

questions.text:
Select the correct statements from the following.
A. No person shall be eligible for appointment as governor unless he is a citizen of India and has completed the age of 35 years.
B. The governor shall not be a member of either House of Parliament or of a House of Legislature of any state specified in the first Schedule.
C. Where the same person is appointed as governor of two or more states, the emoluments and allowances payable to the governor shall be allocated among the states in such proportion as the Parliament may by order determine.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Articles 157 and 158 confirm statements A (citizenship and minimum age 35) and B (no membership of Parliament or a state legislature while Governor); statement C wrongly names Parliament — the President, not Parliament, determines how emoluments are split when one person governs two or more states. Governor eligibility is a compact Article 157–158 package.

questions.text:
Select the correct statement/s from the following.
A. The Governor of each State shall appoint a person who is qualified to be appointed as judge of a High Court to be Advocate General for the State.
B. The Advocate General shall hold office during the pleasure of the Governor and shall receive such remuneration as the State Legislature may determine.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Article 165 empowers the Governor to appoint as Advocate General a person qualified to be a High Court judge; statement B is wrong because remuneration is determined by the Governor, not the State Legislature. Advocate General basics — appointment by Governor, pleasure tenure — sit under the state executive.

questions.text:
Arrange the following states according to their Legislative Council seats in ascending order.
A. Maharashtra
B. Andhra Pradesh
C. Uttar Pradesh
D. Telangana
E. Karnataka
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Legislative Council strengths (ascending): Telangana 40, Andhra Pradesh 58, Karnataka 75, Maharashtra 78, Uttar Pradesh 100 — order D, B, E, A, C. Only six states have Vidhan Parishads; memorising these seat counts saves time in matching questions.

questions.text:
Select the incorrect statement about Constituent Assembly.
A. 'Lion' was adopted as the symbol of the Constituent Assembly.
B. B. N. Rau was appointed as legal advisor to the Constituent Assembly.
C. H. V. R. Iyengar was the secretary to the Constituent Assembly.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Statement A is false — the Constituent Assembly did not adopt the lion as its symbol; B. N. Rau was indeed legal advisor and H. V. R. Iyengar served as secretary. Constituent Assembly facts — personnel and symbols — appear regularly in prelim polity.

questions.text:
Select the incorrect statement/s from the following.
A person shall not be qualified for appointment as a judge of supreme court unless he is a citizen of India and __________.
A. Has been for at least ten years a judge of high court or of two or more such courts in succession.
B. Has been for at least five years an advocate of a high court or of two or more such courts in succession.
C. Is, in the opinion of the President, a distinguished jurist.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Under Article 124(3), a Supreme Court judge needs five years as a High Court judge (not ten, as in A) or ten years as a High Court advocate (not five, as in B); being a distinguished jurist in the President's opinion (C) is a valid route. Swapping the five- and ten-year thresholds is a classic examiner trap.

questions.text:
Select the correct statement/s from the following.
A. Article 137 – Subject to the provisions of any law made by Parliament or any rules made under Article 145, the supreme court shall have power to review any judgement pronounced or order made by it.
B. Article 141 – The law declared by the supreme court shall be binding on all courts within the territory of India.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Article 137 expressly empowers the Supreme Court to review its own judgments, and Article 141 makes the law declared by it binding on all courts in India — both statements reproduce the constitutional text faithfully.

questions.text: Which State was given special status under Article 370 ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Article 370 (now abrogated) granted Jammu and Kashmir a special autonomous status within the Union, distinct from the other States listed in the options.

questions.text: In which Part of the Indian Constitution are "Fundamental Duties" mentioned ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment and placed in Part IV-A; Part III holds Fundamental Rights, not duties.

questions.text: How many languages are included in the eighth Schedule ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Eighth Schedule currently lists 22 languages — the count rose over time as Sindhi, Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali, Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali were added in stages.

questions.text:
Select the correct statements about Chief Minister.
A. He is a Chairman of State Planning Board.
B. He is a Chairman of Zonal Council.
C. He is Vice-Chairman of Inter-State Council.
D. He is the Chief Spokesperson of the State Government.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Chief Minister chairs the State Planning Board and acts as the government's chief spokesperson, but the Union Home Minister heads Zonal Councils and the Prime Minister chairs the Inter-State Council — not the CM.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a fundamental duty ?

options.A: To protect monuments and places of public importance
options.C: To protect and improve the natural environment

questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Protecting monuments and places of national importance is a Directive Principle under Article 49, not one of the eleven Fundamental Duties in Article 51A — the other three options are listed duties.

questions.text:
Match the pairs - (Criticism of the Directive Principles of State Policy).
'A' (Critics)
A. K. T. Shah
B. Ivor Jennings
C. K. C. Wheare
D. T. T. Krishnamachari
'B' (Statement)
i. Pious aspirations
ii. Manifesto of aims and aspirations
iii. A veritable dustbin of sentiments
iv. Pious superfluities

options.A: A – iv, B – i, C – ii, D – iii
options.B: A – iii, B – ii, C – i, D – iv
options.C: A – ii, B – i, C – iii, D – iv
options.D: A – iv, B – ii, C – i, D – iii

questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. K. T. Shah dismissed the DPSP as 'pious superfluities', Jennings as 'pious aspirations', Wheare as a 'manifesto of aims and aspirations', and Krishnamachari as a 'veritable dustbin of sentiments' — the classic pairing set.

questions.text: Which Article provides protection to the Freedom of Speech of members of Parliament in the Parliament ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Article 105 shields MPs' freedom of speech and parliamentary privileges inside Parliament — the constitutional provision the question is pointing at.

questions.text: In which year Maharashtra Government launched Swachhtagrih Scheme for rural families ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Maharashtra launched the Swachhtagrih (individual household toilet) scheme for rural families in 1995, well before the later national sanitation drives.

questions.text: Who among the following was not a member of the Drafting Committee ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. C. Rajagopalachari served the Constituent Assembly in other capacities but was never a member of the seven-member Drafting Committee headed by Dr. Ambedkar — Saadulla, Mitter, and Gopalaswami Ayyangar were.

questions.text: Bhau Mahajan was started the following newspapers.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Bhau Mahajan, the noted journalist and social worker from Maharashtra, founded Dnyandarshan, Dhumketu, and Prabhakar — three influential Marathi periodicals of the reform era.

questions.text: On 31 October 1920 the first session of All India Trade Union Congress was held in Mumbai under whose chairmanship ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The inaugural session of the All India Trade Union Congress on 31 October 1920 in Bombay was presided over by Lala Lajpat Rai, marking a milestone in organised labour politics.

questions.text: Who among the following did not included in the Conference held at Mangaon in Kagal Jahagiri on 21 March 1920 ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. The Mangaon conference of 21 March 1920 in Kagal Jahagiri brought together peasant leaders like Appasaheb Patil, Tukaram Ganeshacharya, and Gangaram Kambale — Dadasaheb Gaikwad was not among those present.

questions.text: During the British rule, which tribal was more populated in Umbargaon, Dahanu, Palghar and Jawhar Sansthan area of Thane district ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. During British rule the Warli community formed the largest tribal population in the Umbargaon, Dahanu, Palghar, and Jawhar sansthan belt of Thane district.

questions.text:
Which of the statement given below is correct in regard to Narayan G. Chandavarkar ?
a. Narayan G. Chandavarkar attended Congress Establishment Session on 28th December 1885.
b. According to Narayan G. Chandavarkar, the reason behind rising poverty of India is the rising population.
c. Narayan G. Chandavarkar criticized British Government's rising expenditure on military at Congress Session held in Mumbai in 1889.
d. Narayan G. Chandavarkar held the position of Vice-chancellor of Mumbai University.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Narayan Chandavarkar attended the first Congress session in 1885, criticised military spending at the 1889 Bombay session, and served as Vice-Chancellor of Bombay University — but he blamed British policy, not population growth, for India's poverty.

questions.text: Who among the following went to Allahabad in February 1918 to attend the All India Hindu Parishad at invitation of Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Dr. Kurtkoti of Maharashtra travelled to Allahabad in February 1918 at Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya's invitation to attend the All India Hindu Parishad.

questions.text: Who established 'Azad Dal' underground military organization in 1945 ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Nagnath Naikawadi set up the underground armed group 'Azad Dal' in 1945 as part of Maharashtra's militant resistance network during the freedom struggle.

questions.text: Who was felicitated in Pune on 24th September 1894 by a organization called Sarvajanik Sabha ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. The Sarvajanik Sabha of Pune honoured Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj on 24 September 1894, recognising his progressive work on social reform in Kolhapur.

questions.text:
Arrange the following incidents in their chronological order.
a. Establishment of Union of Mill Workers in Bombay.
b. First Factory Act.
c. Establishment of Workers Welfare Society.
d. Establishment of All India Trade Union Congress.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. The First Factory Act came in 1881, Bombay's mill-workers' union followed around 1890, the Workers' Welfare Society came next, and the All India Trade Union Congress was founded last in 1920.

questions.text: Who was the general secretary of the reception committee of the Faizpur Congress Session ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Dhanaji Nana Chaudhari served as general secretary of the reception committee for the Faizpur Congress Session (1936), the landmark session held in rural Maharashtra.

questions.text: Who had filed the public interest litigation in the Supreme Court of India to save the Taj Mahal from industrial pollution ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Environmental lawyer M. C. Mehta filed the PIL that pushed the Supreme Court to act on Taj Mahal pollution — leading to orders on industries, green belts, and cleaner fuel around Agra.

questions.text: Which one of the following states of India passed the first resolution for Joint Forest Management ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Odisha passed India's first official resolution on Joint Forest Management, bringing local communities and the forest department together to protect and share forest resources.

questions.text: In 1972 World Vasundhara Conference, the Western Ghats has been declared at which number of the most sensitive region in the world ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. At the 1972 World Vasundhara Conference the Western Ghats were ranked 18th among the world's most ecologically sensitive regions — a reminder of their global conservation value.

questions.text: As per Forest Survey of India, in which of the following district of Maharashtra there is a highest growth in mangrove forest cover between 2013 to 2023 period ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Forest Survey of India data for 2013–2023 shows Raigarh district recording the highest increase in mangrove cover among the listed Maharashtra coastal districts.

questions.text:
Arrange these river basins in Maharashtra from north to south direction.
a. Krishna river basin
b. Bhima river basin
c. Tapti river basin
d. Pravara river basin
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. From north to south across Maharashtra the order is Tapti basin (c), then Pravara (d), Bhima (b), and Krishna (a) — Tapti lies farthest north, Krishna farthest south.

questions.text: Which type of climate is experienced in Maharashtra ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Maharashtra broadly sits in the tropical zone, gets heavy monsoon rain in many parts, and also has distinct dry spells — so tropical, wet, and dry all apply.

questions.text: As per 2011 census, ________ Administrative region of Maharashtra observed lowest child sex ratio.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The 2011 Census placed the Aurangabad administrative division at the bottom for child sex ratio among Maharashtra's regions — a figure often linked to Marathwada's demographic pattern.

questions.text: Under the Kyoto Protocol, which of the following factor requires major domestic changes to reduce it in developed countries ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. The Kyoto Protocol legally binds developed countries to cut greenhouse gas emissions — that is the core domestic policy shift it demands, not tree-felling rules or farm waste alone.

questions.text:
Match the following pairs.
Plants
a. Hirda
b. Khair
c. Rosha Grass
d. Tendu Leaves
Production
i. Scent oil
ii. Tannin
iii. Bidi
iv. Katha/Cutch

options.A: a - iv, b - iii, c - i, d - ii
options.B: a - ii, b - iv, c - iii, d - i
options.C: a - ii, b - iv, c - i, d - iii
options.D: a - ii, b - iii, c - iv, d - i

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Hirda yields tannin, Khair gives katha/cutch, Rosha grass is tapped for scent oil, and Tendu leaves go into bidis — a standard forest-produce matching set.

questions.text: Which of the following mineral is extensively found in Maharashtra ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Iron ore is Maharashtra's most widespread mineral — major deposits run through Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, and the eastern plateau belt, feeding steel plants across the state.

questions.text: What will be the power wattage of bulb which runs on 220 V of home electric supply carrying current of 0.25 A ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Use P = V × I: 220 V × 0.25 A gives 55 W. Keep this formula handy for quick household electricity calculations.

questions.text: Which Radioactive substance is used as a fuel in nuclear power plant ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Uranium-235 (and sometimes plutonium) fuels nuclear reactors through controlled fission. Radium and polonium are radioactive but are not power-plant fuel.

questions.text:
Choose the correct sentence.
i. Sound can travel through vacuum.
ii. The frequency of audible sound is 20 Hz to 20000 Hz.
iii. When a source of sound moves its frequency observed may be different.
iv. Doppler effect is the apparent change in frequency of source when it is moving.

options.B: Only i, ii sentences are correct
options.C: Only ii, iii, iv sentences are correct
options.D: Only i, ii, iii sentences are correct

questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Sound needs a material medium — it cannot travel through vacuum (i is wrong). Human hearing spans roughly 20 Hz–20,000 Hz (ii), and the Doppler effect covers iii and iv.

questions.text:
Organic waste is converted into manure and biogas, is an example of which of the following chemical reaction ?
a. Displacement reaction
b. Addition reaction
c. Substitution reaction
d. Decomposition reaction
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Composting and biogas production break complex organic matter into simpler products — that is decomposition, not displacement or addition chemistry.

questions.text:
Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) and Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) terms are used to determine extend of pollution in ______________.
a. Air
b. Sound
c. Soil
d. Water
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. BOD and COD both measure how much oxygen organic pollutants consume in water — they are standard water-quality indicators, not air, soil, or noise tests.

questions.text:
From the following options, the common name of calcium oxychloride is ____________.
a. Blue vitriol
b. Borax
c. Green vitriol
d. Bleaching powder

options.A: Only a and b are incorrect

questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Calcium oxychloride is common bleaching powder (CaOCl₂), used to disinfect water. Blue vitriol is copper sulphate, borax is sodium borate, green vitriol is ferrous sulphate.

questions.text: Which of the following is not an example of fish ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Ichthyophis is a limbless caecilian — an amphibian, not a fish. Scoliodon (dogfish), Hippocampus (seahorse), and Labeo (rohu) are all true fishes.

questions.text:
The diagnostic features of birds - ______________.
a. Feathers clade
b. Air breathing
c. Warm blooded
d. All of the above
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Birds are diagnosed by feathers, air-breathing lungs, and warm-blooded metabolism — all three together, not any single trait alone.

questions.text:
Match the animal with its respective phylum.
a. Protozoa - i. Butterfly
b. Coelenterata - ii. Plasmodium
c. Arthropoda - iii. Starfish
d. Echinodermata - iv. Hydra
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Plasmodium belongs to Protozoa, Hydra to Coelenterata, Butterfly to Arthropoda, and Starfish to Echinodermata — match each animal to its correct phylum.

questions.text:
To control pests on the crops which of the following ways offer a sustainable and environmental friendly approach ?
i. Chemical pesticide
ii. Mycorrhizae
iii. Crop rotation
iv. Lichens
Which of the following statement given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Mycorrhizae strengthen crop roots naturally and crop rotation breaks pest cycles — both are eco-friendly. Chemical pesticides harm the environment, and lichens are not a pest-control tool.

questions.text: The first system of plant classification based on natural characters was presented in which year and by whom ?

options.D: 1883, G. Bentham and J. D. Hooker

questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Antoine Laurent de Jussieu laid out the first widely accepted natural system of plant classification in 1789 through his work *Genera Plantarum*. Later systems by the Candolles and by Bentham–Hooker built on this foundation.

questions.text: Which of the following is a plant hormone ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Cytokinins are classic plant hormones that drive cell division and delay leaf ageing. Acetylene is a gas, formalin a preservative, and streptomycin an antibiotic — none of these belong to the plant-hormone group.

questions.text: Which one of the following is an example of attribute data in GIS ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. In GIS, attribute data describes the qualities of a feature — such as land-use type — while latitude, longitude, and map extent are spatial data tied to location and geometry.

questions.text: Which of the following instrument is used to view the aerial photographs in three dimension ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. A stereoscope pairs overlapping aerial photographs so each eye sees a slightly different view, giving a three-dimensional impression of terrain. It is a standard photogrammetry tool, not a storage device.

questions.text: Which of the following science is defined as science of acquiring, processing and interpreting statistical data and images obtained from air craft and satellite ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Remote sensing is the science of collecting, processing, and interpreting data and images from aircraft and satellites without physical contact with the target. Aerial photography is one technique within it; GIS and GPS serve different roles.

questions.text: Which of the following portion of electromagnetic spectrum is used in remote sensing ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Satellite and aerial sensors routinely use the visible, infrared, and microwave bands — each suited to different surface properties — so all three regions listed are part of remote-sensing practice.

questions.text: The size of the monitor or video display unit is measured in _________ length of the screen.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Monitor and TV sizes are quoted as the diagonal distance across the screen — the standard industry convention buyers see in shop labels.

questions.text: U.R.L. stands for _________ .
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. URL expands to Uniform Resource Locator — the address string that tells a browser where to fetch a web page or file on the internet.

questions.text: Which of the following is a primary responsibility of the data link layer in the OSI model ?

options.A: Routing packets to their destination across multiple networks
options.B: Encapsulating network layer packets into frames for transmission
options.C: Managing end-to-end communication and ensuring reliable delivery
options.D: Converting data into electrical signals for physical transmission

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The data link layer (Layer 2) wraps network-layer packets into frames for transmission over a physical link. Routing belongs to the network layer; end-to-end reliability to the transport layer; signal conversion to the physical layer.

questions.text: The provisions of the 'Information Technology Act, 2000' came into force on _________ .
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Information Technology Act, 2000 received presidential assent in June, but most of its operative provisions were notified and came into force on 17 October 2000.

questions.text: Which is the unhappiest country in the World Happiness Report 2018 ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The World Happiness Report 2018 placed Burundi at the bottom of the rankings — the least happy country that year — while Finland topped the list.

questions.text: National Population Policy, 2000 aims to stabilize population by which year ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The National Population Policy, 2000 set the long-term goal of stabilising India's population by 2045 through improved healthcare, education, and family-planning measures.

questions.text:
Identify the correct pairs from the given options.

List-I
i. Economic Planning
ii. XIIth Five Year Plan
iii. NITI Aayog
iv. NITI Aayog Vice-chairperson

List-II
a. Selection by Prime Minister
b. Think Tank group of Indian Government
c. Fast and sustainable growth
d. Time bound programme

options.A: i – c, ii – a, iii – d, iv – b
options.B: i – d, ii – b, iii – a, iv – c
options.C: i – d, ii – c, iii – b, iv – a
options.D: i – b, ii – d, iii – c, iv – a

questions.explanation:
Correct matching (option C):
i. Economic Planning → d. Time bound programme
ii. XIIth Five Year Plan → c. Fast and sustainable growth
iii. NITI Aayog → b. Think Tank group of Indian Government
iv. NITI Aayog Vice-chairperson → a. Selection by Prime Minister

As per the official answer key, option C.

questions.text: Absolute poverty is measured by _______.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Absolute poverty in the Indian planning context is measured by whether a person can afford the minimum calorie intake needed for basic survival — not merely by income or wealth on paper.

questions.text: Phillips curve shows the relationship between _______.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. The Phillips curve captures the short-run trade-off between inflation and unemployment — when one tends to fall, the other often rises, a staple macroeconomics graph.

questions.text:
Which is a correct statement ?
A. Devaluation is the reduction of the exchange value of a currency or its purchasing power in term of other currency.
B. The great advantage of devaluation is an increase in import.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Statement A correctly defines devaluation as lowering a currency's exchange value. Statement B is wrong — devaluation usually makes exports cheaper and imports costlier, so it does not increase imports.

questions.text: ______ was the currency of the International Monetary Fund until December, 1971.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Under the Bretton Woods arrangement, the US dollar served as the IMF's principal currency of account until the system was overhauled in December 1971.

questions.text:
The most important and traditional method for the government to raise funds to meet its expenditures is through various taxes. In this context, identify which of the following statement(s) is/are correct.
a. Taxes on goods are generally direct taxes.
b. The Goods and Services Tax (GST) system has been implemented across India since July 1, 2014.
c. "One Nation, One Tax" is the core of GST.
d. Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a single direct tax implemented across the entire nation, replacing previous many central and state indirect taxes.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Only statement c holds — "One Nation, One Tax" is the core idea of GST. Goods taxes are indirect, not direct; GST rolled out on 1 July 2017, not 2014; and GST itself is an indirect tax replacing many earlier ones.

questions.text: When was the National Food Security Act, 2013 implemented in Maharashtra ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Maharashtra notified and began implementing the National Food Security Act, 2013 from 1 February 2014, extending subsidised food-grain entitlements under the central law.

questions.text:
Role of foreign trade is _________ .
a. To earn foreign exchange.
b. To encourage investment.
c. Lead to division of labour.
d. Bring change in composition of exports.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Foreign trade earns foreign exchange, attracts investment, and promotes international division of labour through specialisation. Shifting export composition is also a long-run effect, but the keyed answer covers a, b, and c.

title: Group C Mains 2024 - General Studies & Intelligence Test (मराठी) (Set A)

questions.text:
प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी योग्य पर्याय सुचवा.
D 16 N : H 2 S
B 256 M : ?
questions.explanation: आयोगाने रद्द केलेला प्रश्न (उत्तरतालिकेत '#' अशी नोंद). अक्षर–संख्या सादृश्य कोडिंगवरील हा प्रश्न गुणांकनासाठी धरला जात नाही.

questions.text: खालील वेन आकृतीनुसार, जास्तीत जास्त विद्यार्थ्यांनी कोणता विषय निवडला आहे ? [वेन आकृतीमध्ये चार वर्तुळे एकमेकांना छेदतात. वरचे वर्तुळ 'इतिहास', डावे 'गणित', उजवे 'भूगोल' आणि खालचे 'विज्ञान' दर्शवते. आकृतीमध्ये विविध भागांत खालीलप्रमाणे अंक दिले आहेत: इतिहास फक्त-१६, गणित फक्त-९, भूगोल फक्त-९, विज्ञान फक्त-१९, गणित व इतिहास-१४, इतिहास व भूगोल-१२, गणित व विज्ञान-१५, विज्ञान व भूगोल-१६, गणित-इतिहास-विज्ञान-१८, इतिहास-भूगोल-विज्ञान-१८, गणित-इतिहास-भूगोल-१३, गणित-भूगोल-विज्ञान-१३ आणि चारही विषयांच्या मध्यभागी-२०.]
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. 'विज्ञान' असलेले सर्व भाग मिळवले — फक्त-विज्ञान (१९) आणि प्रत्येक छेदनभाग — तर एकूण ११९ येते, जे इतिहास (१११), गणित (१०२) आणि भूगोल (१०१) पेक्षा जास्त आहे. चार वर्तुळांच्या वेन आकृतीत प्रत्येक विषयासाठी त्या वर्तुळ असलेले सर्व भाग बेरीज करा.

questions.text:
प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी येणारी संख्या कोणती ते ओळखा.
2, 12, 30, 56, 90, ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय D. पदांमधील फरक १०, १८, २६, ३४ — प्रत्येक वेळी ८ ने वाढतात; पुढचा फरक ४२, म्हणून ९० + ४२ = १३२. दुसऱ्या-स्तरीय फरक स्थिर असल्यास शेवटच्या फरकात तो वाढीव घालून पुढचे पद मिळते.

questions.text: श्याम हा रामपेक्षा उंच आहे. राम हा अमिरपेक्षा उंच आहे. सुधिर हा शिशिरपेक्षा उंच आहे. शिशिर हा रामपेक्षा उंच आहे. तर सर्वात कमी उंच कोण ?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C योग्य आहे. श्याम > राम > अमिर आणि सुधिर > शिशिर > राम — या साऱ्या क्रमात अमिर सर्वात खाली आहे. सर्व नावे एकाच उंची क्रमवारीत लिहून मग सर्वात कमी उंच ओळखा.

questions.text: दिलेल्या उदाहरणात, पहिल्या तीन मांडण्यांचा अभ्यास करून प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी काय येईल ते निवडा. [आकृतीमध्ये चार वर्तुळ आहेत. प्रत्येक वर्तुळाच्या बाहेर चार दिशांना (वर, खाली, डावीकडे, उजवीकडे) संख्या आहेत आणि वर्तुळाच्या मध्यभागी एक संख्या आहे. वर्तुळ १: वर ३, डावीकडे २, उजवीकडे ५, खाली ४; मध्यभागी १९६. वर्तुळ २: वर ५, डावीकडे १, उजवीकडे ४, खाली ३; मध्यभागी १६९. वर्तुळ ३: वर ३, डावीकडे ५, उजवीकडे ५, खाली ३; मध्यभागी २५६. वर्तुळ ४: वर ७, डावीकडे ६, उजवीकडे ५, खाली ३; मध्यभागी ?]
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. प्रत्येक वर्तुळात बाहेरील चार संख्यांची बेरीज करून तिचा वर्ग मध्यभागी लिहिला आहे: १४² = १९६, १३² = १६९, १६² = २५६; ७+६+५+३ = २१, म्हणून २१² = ४४१. पहिल्या तीन आकृत्यांतील वर्गाचा नियम ओळखून चौथ्यासाठी लागू करा.

questions.text: एक विशिष्ट रक्कम A, B आणि C मध्ये अनुक्रमे 2 : 3 : 4 या प्रमाणात वितरित करायची होती, परंतु ती चुकीने अनुक्रमे 7 : 2 : 5 या प्रमाणात वितरित केली गेली. याचा परिणाम म्हणून B ला रु. 30,000/- कमी मिळाले. तर ती रक्कम किती होती ?
questions.explanation: उत्तरतालिकेनुसार पर्याय A योग्य आहे. B चा योग्य वाटा ३/९ आणि चुकीचा २/१४; फरक (३/९ − २/१४) = ४/२१, आणि ४/२१ × एकूण = ३०,०००, म्हणून एकूण रक्कम १,५७,५०० रु. अशा प्रश्नांत प्रत्येकाचा योग्य आणि चुकीचा वाटा तुलना करून फरक काढा.

questions.text: समजा तुमच्या घड्याळात नऊ वाजले आहेत. जर तास काटा पश्चिमेकडे आहे, तर मिनिट काटा कोणत्या दिशेला राहील ?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. नऊ वाजता मिनिट काटा १२ वर असतो; तास काटा ९ वर पश्चिमेला असेल तर १२ची दिशा उत्तर होते. घड्याळ फिरवलेले कल्पून १२ कोणत्या दिशेला आहे ते पाहा — मिनिट काट्याची दिशा ठरते.

questions.text: पंकज, किरण व अनिल या तिघांना रु. 1,000/-, 2 : 3 : 5 या प्रमाणात वाटले. तर किरणच्या वाट्याला किती रुपये येतील ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय C. किरणचा वाटा २+३+५ = १० पैकी ३, म्हणून (३/१०) × १,००० = ३०० रु. साध्या प्रमाण वाटपात एकूण प्रमाणातील आपला भाग गुणून संपूर्ण रक्कम मिळवा.

questions.text: खालील आकृत्यांचे निरीक्षण करा व प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी येणारी योग्य आकृती निवडा. [पहिल्या भागात एक वर्तुळ आणि एक त्रिकोण आहे, त्यानंतर एक आकृती आहे ज्यात त्रिकोणाच्या शिरोबिंदूवर वर्तुळ ठेवले आहे. दुसऱ्या भागात एक आडवा आयत आणि एक उभा आयत आहे, त्यानंतर प्रश्नचिन्ह आहे.]

options.A: एक आडव्या आयताच्या मध्यभागी वरच्या बाजूला एक उभा आयत आहे, जो उलट्या 'T' सारखा दिसतो
options.B: एक आडव्या आयताच्या डाव्या टोकाला एक उभा आयत जोडलेला आहे, जो 'L' आकार तयार करतो
options.C: एक आडव्या आयताच्या उजव्या टोकाला एक उभा आयत जोडलेला आहे
options.D: एका उभ्या आयताच्या वरच्या टोकाला मध्यभागी एक आडवा आयत जोडलेला आहे, जो 'T' आकार तयार करतो

questions.explanation: पर्याय D योग्य आहे. पहिल्या जोडीत वर्तुळ त्रिकोणाच्या शिरोबिंदूवर ठेवले आहे; दुसऱ्या जोडीत आडवा आयत उभ्या आयताच्या वरच्या मध्यभागी 'T' आकारात जोडला पाहिजे. अशा आकृती सादृश्यात दोन आकृत्यांमधील स्थानिक संबंध तसाच राहतो.

questions.text:
1 1/2 ÷ 3 3/5 = ?
खालीलपैकी योग्य पर्याय निवडा.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. १½ ÷ ३⅗ = (३/२) ÷ (१८/५) = (३/२) × (५/१८) = १५/३६. मिश्र संख्या अयोग्य भिन्नराशीत बदलल्यावर भागाकार सोपा होतो.

questions.text:
खालीलपैकी योग्य विधान/ने निवडा :
अ. PRERNA चा 15 जानेवारी 2024 ते 17 फेब्रुवारी 2024 या कालावधीत गुजरातमधील वडनगर येथील एका स्थानिक शाळेत प्रायोगिक टप्पा सुरू झाला.
ब. PRERNA हा साप्ताहिक निवासी कार्यक्रम आहे, जो इयत्ता V ते VIII पर्यंतच्या निवडक विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी संरचित केलेला आहे.
questions.explanation: उत्तरतालिकेनुसार पर्याय A योग्य आहे. PRERNA चा १५ जानेवारी ते १७ फेब्रुवारी २०२४ या कालावधीत गुजरातच्या वडनगर येथील शाळेत प्रायोगिक टप्पा सुरू झाला; विधान ब कार्यक्रमाचे स्वरूप चुकीचे सांगते, म्हणून फक्त अ बरोबर. योजना प्रश्नांत नेमका सुरुवातीचा कालावधी आणि ठिकाण लक्षात ठेवा.

questions.text: भारतीय संसदेच्या नूतन इमारतीमध्ये स्थापित करण्यात आलेला 'सेंगोल' राजदंड हा कोणत्या साम्राज्याचे/राजवटीचे प्रतीक आहे ?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. नवीन संसद भवनात स्थापन केलेला 'सेंगोल' राजदंड चोल परंपरेतील न्यायी राज्य आणि सत्ता हस्तांतरणाच्या प्रतीकाचा आहे. २०२३ मधील स्थापनेत हा विधी थेट चोल वारशाशी जोडला गेला.

questions.text: सर्वोत्कृष्ट पार्श्वगायकाचा 70 वा राष्ट्रीय चित्रपट पुरस्कार अरिजीत सिंग ला __________ गीतासाठी प्रदान करण्यात आला.
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय D. ७०व्या राष्ट्रीय चित्रपट पुरस्कारात अरिजीत सिंगला 'केसरिया' (ब्रह्मास्त्र) गीतासाठी सर्वोत्कृष्ट पार्श्वगायक पुरस्कार मिळाला. चित्रपट पुरस्कार प्रश्नांत कलाकार आणि नेमके गीत नाव लक्षात ठेवा.

questions.text: थायलंडच्या माजी पंतप्रधान पायतोंगटार्न शिनावात्रा ह्या कोणत्या राजकीय पक्षाच्या नेत्या आहेत ?
questions.explanation: पर्याय B योग्य आहे. २०२४ मध्ये थोड्या काळासाठी थायलंडची पंतप्रधान राहिलेली पायतोंगटार्न शिनावात्रा 'फेऊ थाई' पक्षाची नेता आहे — हा पक्ष तिच्या वडील ठाकसिन शिनावात्र यांनी स्थापन केला. आंतरराष्ट्रीय नेते-पक्षाची जोडी लक्षात ठेवा.

questions.text: जानेवारी 2025 मध्ये भारतीय क्रिकेट नियामक मंडळाच्या सचिव पदी कोणाची निवड करण्यात आली आहे ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. जानेवारी २०२५ मध्ये देवजीत सैकिया यांची भारतीय क्रिकेट नियामक मंडळाच्या (BCCI) सचिव पदी निवड झाली. BCCI मधील पदबदल हे सामान्य चालू घडामोडी प्रश्न असतात.

questions.text:
जोड्या लावा – (अर्जुन पुरस्कार, 2024).
List 'अ' (खेळाडू)
अ. वांतिका अग्रवाल

क. अभय सिंह
