questions.text: White revolution started in India from _______ year.
questions.explanation: Operation Flood—the White Revolution—launched in 1971 under Verghese Kurien's AMUL-led dairy network, transforming India into a milk-surplus economy. 1972–1974 mark expansion phases but 1971 is the standard start year in planning and NDDB chronology.

questions.text: The local rock used to construct houses in rural area on the Deccan Plateau of Maharashtra is
questions.explanation: Option D is the right choice since Rural Deccan houses in Maharashtra commonly use locally quarried basalt (trap)—the volcanic rock of the plateau. Laterite is more coastal/Konkan; marble is scarce and costly; granite appears regionally but basalt is the default 'Deccan trap' building stone in textbooks. Distractors A (Laterite rock), B (Marble rock), C (Granite rock) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: The row-row transportation started firstly in India on which railway route?
questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because Option C is correct. North-eastern, southern, or eastern trunk lines did not debut this truck-on-rail service the question targets. questions.text: As per the Champion and Seth's classification, how many major types of forests are present in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: Option A matches the question because Champion & Seth classified Maharashtra forests into six major types—tropical wet evergreen, semi-evergreen, moist deciduous, littoral, dry deciduous, and dry scrub/thorn variants in their schema. Counts of 3–5 undercount the diversity recognised in Maharashtra forest surveys tied to this classic classification. You can eliminate B (5), C (4), D (3) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. questions.text: Which city of India has been declared as cleanest city for three consecutive years (2019 to 2021) by Swachh ranking of Government of India?
questions.explanation: Choose option A: indore topped Swachh Survekshan as India's cleanest city for three consecutive years 2019–2021—before Surat and others rose in later rankings. Pune, Mumbai, and Surat competed strongly but did not hold the three-year streak the question specifies. Distractors B (Pune), C (Mumbai), D (Surat) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: Railseema Plateau is located in _______ region.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — Rayalaseema (Railseema) plateau lies east of the Karnataka plateau—Andhra's rain-shadow upland separated from the Deccan by the Eastern Ghats. North, west, or south of Karnataka misplaces this semi-arid plateau that extends into Telangana/Andhra geography. You can eliminate A (North of Karnataka Plateau), B (West of Karnataka Plateau), C (South of Karnataka Plateau) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. questions.text: For 2011-12 planning commission had defined poverty line with the help of following criteria.

options.B: ₹47 and ₹32 per capita income per day in rural areas and urban areas respectively
options.C: ₹49.63 and ₹56.64 per capita income per day in rural areas and urban areas respectively

questions.text:
Special Area Development Programme has been formulated for
a. Poverty eradication and employment growth
b. To develop hilly and tribal area
c. To develop drought prone area
d. Industrialization in the rural area
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Special Area Development Programmes target backward hilly/tribal tracts (b) and drought-prone districts (c)—not standalone rural industrialisation (d) or generic poverty eradication alone (a). Options picking only poverty (a) or industry (d) miss the spatially targeted hill–drought focus SAPDA schemes address. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Which are the instruments of fiscal policy?
a. Public spending and public debt
b. Democracy and federal structure
c. Taxation and budget
d. Parliament and administration
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Fiscal policy instruments are public spending/debt (a) and taxation/budget (c)—not democracy/federal structure (b) or parliament/administration (d), which are political institutions. Bundling constitutional features with fiscal tools confuses governance structure with macroeconomic levers. questions.text: Who launched Ujwal Discom Assurance Yojana?
questions.explanation: Option A matches the question because UDAY (Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana) was launched by the Central Government in 2015 to revive state electricity distribution companies. State governments, MSEB alone, or LIC did not singly launch this restructuring scheme—central MoP coordination is the core fact. questions.text: Which of the following committee was appointed to recommend tax reforms in India in August 1991?
questions.explanation: Dr Raja Chelliah chaired the tax-reforms committee appointed in August 1991 to overhaul indirect and direct taxes after liberalisation. Narasimham handled banking reforms; Chakravarty planning; Abid Husain trade—assigning tax reform to any of them misdates the Chelliah report.

questions.text: What was the share of self employed, regular employees and casual labours in the total workforce in 2011-12?

Reversing regular and self-employed (B) or pushing casual to 62% (C) contradicts the Employment–Unemployment Survey structure where self-employment still dominated India's workforce.

Distractors A (August, 2020), B (August, 2019), C (August, 2022) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.explanation: Crop Diversification Programme (2013–14 onward) runs as a sub-scheme under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY), promoting alternate crops in paddy/wheat belts. Operation Greens focuses on TOP crops; ODOP and BPKP are different flagship programmes—not CPD's parent scheme.

questions.text: The 12th Finance Commission recommended the continuance of the scheme of National Calamity Relief Fund with contributions from the Centre and the States in the ratio of

State governments, MSEB alone, or LIC did नाही singly launch this restructuring scheme—central MoP coordination is the अधिकृत कीनुसार fact पर्याय B (राज्य सरकार) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (महाराष्ट्र विद्युत बोर्ड) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (जीवन बीमा निगम) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: ऑगस्ट 1991 मध्ये भारतातील कर सुधारणा शिफारसीसाठी खालीलपैकी कोणती समिती नियुक्त करण्यात आली होती?
questions.explanation: Dr Raja Chelliah chaired the tax-reforms समिती appointed in August 1991 to overhaul indirect and direct taxes after liberalisation. Narasimham handled banking reforms; Chakravarty planning; Abid Husain trade—assigning tax reform to any of them misdates the Chelliah report पर्याय B (एम. नरसिंहम) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (डॉ. सुखमॉय चक्रवर्ती) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (डॉ. अबीद हुसेन) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: 2011-12 मध्ये एकूण श्रमशक्तीमध्ये स्वयंरोजगार, नियमीत रोजगार आणि प्रासंगिक रोजगाराचा काय हिस्सा होता?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A (स्वयंरोजगार 52%, नियमीत 18%, प्रासंगिक 30%) — सोडवत गेल्यास — NSSO २०११–१२: स्वयंरोजगार ≈५२%, नियमित ≈१८%, प्रासंगिक ≈३०% पर्याय B (स्वयंरोजगार 30%, नियमीत 52%, प्रासंगिक …) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (स्वयंरोजगार 20%, नियमीत 18%, प्रासंगिक …) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (यापैकी नाही) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.explanation: पर्याय D (ऑगस्ट, 2021) — करंट — NMEO-OP (राष्ट्रीय खाद्य तेल–तेल पाम मिशन) ऑगस्ट २०२१ पर्याय A (ऑगस्ट, 2020) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (ऑगस्ट, 2019) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (ऑगस्ट, 2022) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: पीक विविधीकरण कार्यक्रम 2013-14 पासून __________ ची उपयोजना म्हणून राबविण्यात आला.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (राष्ट्रीय कृषी विकास योजना) — Crop Diversification Programme 2013–14 onward RKVY sub-योजना alternate crops paddy/wheat पट्टाs पर्याय A (ऑपरेशन ग्रीन्स) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (एक जिल्हा एक उत्पादन) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (भारतीय प्राकृतिक कृषी पद्धती योजना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:

questions.text:
2023-24 च्या अर्थसंकल्पात खालीलपैकी कोणते प्राधान्य क्रम आहेत?

questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. अर्थसंकल्प २०२३–२४ सात प्राधान्य: सर्वसमावेशक (a), हरित (b), युवा (c), वित्तीय (d) — चारही 'सप्तर्षी' पर्याय A (अ आणि ड) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (ब आणि क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (अ आणि ब) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: 12 व्या वित्त आयोगाने राष्ट्रीय आपत्ती निवारण निधीची योजना केंद्र आणि राज्यांच्या योगदानासह __________ च्या प्रमाणात चालू ठेवण्याची शिफारस केली.
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात 12 व्या वित्त आयोगाने राष्ट्रीय आपत्ती निवारण निधीची योजना केंद्र आणि… — पर्याय C (75 : 25) बरोबर आहे पर्याय A (25 : 75) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (50 : 50) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (90 : 10) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही।

अ. युटीजीएसटी, केंद्र सरकार आणि केंद्रशासित प्रदेश सरकारांद्वारे गोळा केले जोतात.
ब. आयजीएसटी, केंद्र सरकार आणि राज्य सरकारे गोळा करतात.

options.C: दोन्ही अ आणि ब अयोग्य आहेत

questions.explanation: दोन्ही GST विधाने are चुकी as framed: UTGST is levied by Union Territories (collection mechanics differ from 'Central + UT' wording in a), and IGST is collected by the Centre but shared—not 'Centre + State' joint collection in the sense (b) claims। 'फक्त a' or 'फक्त b' misses that दोन्ही limbs चुक पर्याय A (फक्त अ अयोग्य आहे) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय B (फक्त ब अयोग्य आहे) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (वरीलपैकी नाही) योग्य जोडी/विधान नाकारतो, पण प्रश्नाच्या तथ्यांनुसार बरोबर उत्तर अस्तित्वात आहे।

questions.text:
मानवी विकास निर्देशांकामध्ये बहुआयामी दारिद्र्य निर्देशांकाचे __________ तीन आयाम प्रतिबिंबित होतात.
अ. आरोग्य
ब. उत्पन्न
क. शिक्षण
ड. राहणीमान
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (अ, क आणि ड) — Global MPI uses health (a), education (c), and living standards (d)—mirroring HDI dimensions but replacing income with living-मानक indicators. Income (b) is हे separate MPI dimension; options bundling income with health misstate the OPHI–UNDP methodology पर्याय A (अ, ब आणि क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (ब, क आणि ड) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (अ, ब आणि ड) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: सप्टेंबर 2001 मध्ये जवाहर ग्राम समृद्धी योजना आणि रोजगार शाश्वती योजना __________ या योजनेत एकत्रित करण्यात आल्या.
questions.explanation: पर्याय A (संपूर्ण ग्रामीण रोजगार योजना) — 2001 JGSY–EAS integration target नाहीत पर्याय B (स्वर्णजयंती ग्राम स्वरोजगार योजना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (प्रधान मंत्री ग्रामोदय योजना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (स्वर्णजयंती शहरी रोजगार योजना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: वित्तीय जबाबदारी आणि अंदाजपत्रक व्यवस्थापन कायदा, 2003 (एफ आर बी एम कायदा, 2003) असे नमूद करतो की केंद्र सरकारने __________ पर्यंत महसूली तूट दूर करण्यासाठी योग्य उपाययोजना करणे आवश्यक आहे.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (2008 – 09) — अर्थशास्त्रात — FRBM २००३ revenue तूट ३१ मार्च २००९ (२००८–०९) शून्य — नंतर सुधारित पर्याय A (2004 – 05) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (2010 – 11) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही; पर्याय D (2015 – 16) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही।

questions.text: भारतातील पहिल्या सोन्याच्या एटीएम चे उद्घाटन कोणत्या शहरात करण्यात आले?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात भारतातील पहिल्या सोन्याच्या एटीएम चे उद्घाटन कोणत्या शहरात करण्यात आल… — पर्याय B (हैदराबाद) बरोबर आहे पर्याय A (वाराणसी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (लखनौ) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (कोची) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणाला राजीव गांधी खेलरत्न पुरस्कार 2020 ने सन्मानित करण्यात आले?
questions.explanation: Rohit Sharma received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna (now Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna) for 2020—honouring his cricket achievements in the delayed 2020 award cycle. Tendulkar, Dhoni, and Kohli won earlier; Rohit's 2020 recognition is the अधिकृत कीनुसार current-affairs fact पर्याय A (सचिन तेंडूलकर) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (महेंद्रसिंग धोनी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (विराट कोहली) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: 2020 मधील लॉकडाऊन दरम्यान, कृषी व शेतकरी कल्याण मंत्रालयाने कृषी उत्पादनांच्या सुलभ वाहतुकीसाठी हे मोबाईल ॲप्लिकेशन सुरू केले.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (किसान रथ) — Kisan Rath mobile app (2020 lockdown) connected farmers, transporters, and markets for agri-produce movement when supply chains were disrupted. Kisan Express/Connect and Krishi Network are different or later platforms—ते MoAFW lockdown logistics app पर्याय A (किसान एक्सप्रेस) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (किसान कनेक्ट) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (कृषी नेटवर्क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: पद्मविभूषण पुरस्काराने सन्मानित झालेल्या प्रभा अत्रे कोणत्या क्षेत्राशी संबंधित आहेत?
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (संगीत) — Padma Vibhushan awardee Dr Prabha Atre is a Hindustani classical vocalist of the Kirana gharana—not literature, sport, or civil service. questions.text: 2022 मध्ये आयोजित 'अखिल भारतीय राजभाषा परिषदेचे' यजमान कोणते शहर आहे?
questions.explanation: The All-India Official Language Conference 2022 was hosted in Surat—Gujarat's venue for Hindi propagation meetings. questions.text:
'कुडास कान, ठेवी ध्यान' या म्हणीचा योग्य अर्थ कोणता?

Pairing (c) with (d) doubles the mismatch with the proverb's core counsel. You can eliminate A (an amendment in the Constitution of Ind…), B (a decision of the Union Cabinet of India), D (an order of the President of India) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: How much is the ionisation energy of the Hydrogen atom?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen's ionisation energy is 13.6 eV—option B—the ground-state binding energy from Bohr-model spectroscopy. 786 eV and 1 MeV are orders-of-magnitude distractors; 0 eV would imply no binding at all.

questions.text: Due to which of the following process white light gets separated into its constituent colors when passing through a prism?
questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because White light splits into colours in a prism because of dispersion—option C—wavelength-dependent refractive index. Reflection and mere refraction without wavelength separation do not produce the full spectrum; total internal reflection needs a different geometry. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: In alpha decay, the unstable nucleus emits an alpha particle reducing its proton and neutron by:
questions.explanation: Choose option A: alpha decay ejects a ⁴He nucleus (2 protons + 2 neutrons), so Z drops by 2 and N by 2—option A. Single-unit changes describe beta processes, not alpha emission. You can eliminate B (Z by 1 and N by 2), C (Z by 2 and N by 1), D (Z by 1 and N by 1) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which atom does not contain neutron?
questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since Ordinary hydrogen (¹H) has no neutron in its nucleus—option B. Deuterium and tritium have one and two neutrons respectively; helium-4 has two neutrons—students often confuse isotopes of hydrogen with helium. Distractors A (Deuterium), C (Tritium), D (Helium) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: When CO₂ is passed into a concentrated solution of NaCl which is saturated with NH₃, Crystals of _______ separate out.
questions.explanation: Passing CO₂ into NH₃-saturated NaCl yields sodium bicarbonate crystals—option A—via the Solvay/ammonia-soda intermediate step before heating to carbonate. Direct Na₂CO₃ or ammonium salt precipitation misstates the first product of this industrial sequence.

questions.text: Which of the following does not obey octet rule?
questions.explanation: All listed species violate the octet rule—option D: BeCl₂ (electron deficient), BCl₃ (six electrons on B) and PCl₅ (expanded octet on P). Picking any single compound ignores the question's 'which does not' collective framing answered as all three.

questions.text: _______ element is used for digitalization of forest area.
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Polygon elements digitise areal forest boundaries on GIS maps—option C. Points mark spots, lines mark routes/streams; 'above all' is vague when the question targets closed forest parcels. Distractors A (Point), B (Line), D (Above all) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Short-range Network is called _______.
questions.explanation: Bluetooth is the short-range wireless personal-area network—option A. Computer, mobile and printer name devices, not the PAN protocol itself.

questions.text: In India aerial photography started in _______ year.
questions.explanation: Option A matches the question because aerial photography in India began in 1920—option A—during early survey/mapping projects. 1921, 1951 and 1971 mark later cartographic or satellite-era milestones, not the first aerial epoch. You can eliminate B (1921), C (1951), D (1971) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: The Authentication of the electronic record shall be effected by the use of _______ and hash function which envelop and transform the initial electronic record into another electronic record.
questions.explanation: Choose option B: the IT Act authenticates electronic records through asymmetric crypto and hash functions—option B—creating a transformed secure record. Plain 'digital signature' labels the outcome; generic cryptography/crypto-function terms miss the statutory 'asymmetric crypto system' wording. Distractors A (Digital Signature), C (Cryptography), D (Crypto Function) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Malware can be classified as:
(a) Viruses and Worms (b) Trojan Horses (c) Spyware (d) Softcon
questions.explanation: Malware classes include viruses/worms, trojans and spyware—option C—all real categories. 'Softcon' is a fabricated label not used in security taxonomy.

questions.text: The software that controls computer hardware is _______.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option B — the operating system controls hardware resources—option B. Cables are physical media; COBOL is a language; a compiler translates code—it does not schedule CPU/memory/devices. You can eliminate A (Cable), C (COBOL), D (Compiler) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Cyber Crime involves activities such as:
(a) Child pornography (b) Credit Card Fraud
(c) Defaming another person online (d) Gaining unauthorized access to computer Systems
questions.explanation: Option D works here because all listed activities are cyber-crimes—option D: child pornography, card fraud, online defamation and unauthorised system access fall under IT Act and allied penal provisions. Partial pairs undercount the breadth the question asserts. Distractors A ((a) and (b) only), B ((c) and (d) only), C ((a), (b) and (d) only) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which kind of settlement pattern is found in Sahyadri ranges of Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: This maps to "Step pattern". The Sahyadri (Western Ghats) is a UNESCO World Heritage biodiversity hotspot running ~1,600 km along India's west coast and defines the Konkan-Deccan divide in Maharashtra. Note that the wrong options carry closely related terminology; a five-second sanity check against the stem is enough to eliminate them.

questions.text: India is having how many neighbouring countries?
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: india shares land borders with seven countries—option A: Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar and Afghanistan (POK contact). Counts of six/eight/nine omit Afghanistan or double-count incorrectly. You can eliminate B (6), C (8), D (9) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: The total length of Tapi River is:
questions.explanation: The paper's official answer is 724 km. The Tapi river is one of only three major peninsular rivers that flow west; it rises at Multai in MP and drains into the Arabian Sea through Gujarat. The safest way to lock this item into recall is to write the correct option next to its associated year or body in your revision notebook and skim it weekly.

questions.text: In Himachal Pradesh the Bhakra dam built on which river?
questions.explanation: Bhakra Dam in Himachal Pradesh stands on the Sutlej—option A. Ravi, Chenab and Beas host other Bhakra-Nangal system components but not the main Bhakra arch dam site.

questions.text: _______ hill is situated between Bhima river and Godavari river.
questions.explanation: "Harishchandra Balaghat" is what the question is looking for. The Godavari, the longest river of the Deccan (~1,465 km, ~668 km in Maharashtra), rises at Brahmagiri near Trimbakeshwar (Nashik) and drains eastward into the Bay of Bengal. The Bhima river, the largest tributary of the Krishna, rises at Bhimashankar in Pune district and joins the Krishna in Karnataka after crossing Solapur. Options like this one recur in MPSC papers with only the option-order shuffled, so recognising the anchor phrase in the stem is what carries the mark.

questions.text: Which ocean was located between Angara and Gondawana land?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — the Tethys Sea lay between Angara (north) and Gondwana (south) before Himalaya formation—option D. Pacific, Atlantic and Red Sea are unrelated to this Palaeozoic–Mesozoic assembly story. Distractors A (Pacific ocean), B (Red sea), C (Atlantic ocean) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: _______ is a heavy rainfall place in south Konkan.
questions.explanation: Amboli in south Konkan records among the heaviest rainfall stations—option C. Igatpuri and Matheran are wet but inland/ghat-edge; Mahabaleshwar is plateau hill country with high rain yet Amboli tops Konkan lists in many atlases.

questions.text:
Find the number at the place of star in given number pyramid.
19, 43, 37, 26, 39
  24, 6, 11, 13
    30, 17, 24
      13, 7
        ☆
questions.explanation: In the pyramid each upper cell equals the sum of the two cells below it: 13 + 7 = 20—option D. Using difference or single-column addition yields 6, 16 or 18 without satisfying the full upward sums (30 = 13+17, 24 = 17+7).

questions.text: In the following diagram, rectangle represents females, triangle represents educated, circle represents rural and square represents self employed. Who among the following is uneducated self employed rural female?
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Region 3 lies inside the rural circle and self-employed square but outside the educated triangle and inside the female rectangle—option D—the uneducated, self-employed rural female. Regions 4, 5 and 18 is wrong one or more of those set conditions. Distractors A (4), B (18), C (5) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Pari collected data from 800 students about favourite subjects. (Pie chart: Maths 36%, English 28%, Science 11%, Hindi 7%, History 8%, Geography 6%, Marathi ?%). How many students like Marathi subject?
questions.explanation: Marathi share = 100 − (36+28+11+7+8+6) = 4%. Of 800 students, 4% = 32—option B. Treating 4 as absolute count or mis-scaling to 1440/40 ignores the pie-chart percentage logic.

questions.text: Vinay remembered that his mother's birthday is after 26 August but before 29th August. While his brother Vikas remembered that his mother's birthday is after 27th August but before 30th August. What is the birth date of their mother?
questions.explanation: Choose option C: Vinay: after 26, before 29 → {27,28}; Vikas: after 27, before 30 → {28,29}. The overlap is 28 August—option C. 26–27 is wrong Vikas's lower bound; 30 lies outside Vinay's upper bound. You can eliminate A (26 August), B (27 August), D (30 August) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Find out the proper term at the place of question mark.
FVJ : HXD : : ? : TWP
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Letter-shift code: F→H, V→X, J→D (+2 each in the correct pair FVJ→HXD. Applying the same step to TWP gives NUR—option C. BTW, DYV and JVF break the consistent +2 forward alphabet shift. Distractors A (BTW), B (DYV), D (JVF) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Find out the number for question mark:
81/20/64 (base 9), 36/23/144 (base 25), 49/18/? (base 4)
questions.explanation: In the correct base pattern the third segment squares the first digit group: 7² = 49 displayed with middle term 18 and missing 81—option A. 72, 53 and 01 do not complete the 49/18/? lattice under the paper's radix rule.

questions.text:
Find out the correct number for empty space:
(8)(4)(2)→621, (9)(6)(3)→611, (7)(8)(9)→543, (2)(2)(1), (3)(5)(2), (?)(?)(?)
What are the missing numbers?
questions.explanation: Option D works here because From prior rows, (8)(4)(2)→621 encodes digit transforms yielding (2)(4)(6) for the blank triple—option D. Triples 423, 322 and 643 is wrong to reproduce the 611/543 pattern when the same operator set is applied downward. You can eliminate A (4 2 3), B (3 2 2), C (6 4 3) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Which number will replace question mark in the series?
31, 15, 6, ?, 1
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Subtract successive squares: 31−16=15, 15−9=6, 6−4=2, 2−1=1—option C. Linear steps of −16 or stopping at 4/7 break the 4²,3²,2²,1² gap structure. Distractors A (7), B (4), D (1) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.
The operator means division: 8×2=4 because 8÷2=4, likewise 16×8=2. So 40×5 = 40÷5 = 8—option B. Treating × as multiplication gives 200; halving once yields 20 or 10.

questions.text: An examination of 20 questions is taken for Bank recruitment. 5 marks are awarded for the correct answer and 2 marks are deducted for the wrong answer. Spandan has solved 10 questions correctly in that examination, then what will be his score?
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Ten correct answers score 10×5 = 50 marks; if the remaining ten are wrong, penalty 10×2 = 20, net 30—option B. Scores of 20/40/50 assume all unanswered or all correct—contradicting the stated attempt pattern. You can eliminate A (20), C (40), D (50) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: If the sum of two numbers is 50 and their difference is 22, then the smaller number is?
questions.explanation: The official Set A key selects 14. This is a classic MPSC 'anchor-word' item — the stem contains one specific term (a proper noun, a date, an article number) that maps directly to only one option.

questions.text: In a group there are five persons A, B, C, D and E. B is the brother of C. In these five people there is one couple. E is the husband. A and D are female friends and they are unmarried. Who is a wife of 'E'?
questions.explanation: E is the husband in the only couple; B is C's brother (male); A and D are unmarried females—so C is E's wife—option B. Naming B (male sibling) or unmarried A/D as wife violates the couple constraint.

questions.text:
If mean of the following data is 6, then find out the value of P:
X: 2, 4, 6, 10, P+5
f: 3, 2, 3, 1, 2
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — Mean 6 with total frequency 11 → Σfx = 66. Sum of known terms = 52, so 2(P+5) = 14 → P = 7—option C. P = 66 or 14 confuse the unknown class mark with the solved P; P = 3 under-shoots the mean. You can eliminate A (66), B (14), D (03) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: In the morning Neelam starts to walk towards the Sun and walks 8 km. She turns left at 90° and goes 12 km, and then again turns right at 90° and goes 8 km. How far and in which direction is she from her starting point?
questions.explanation: Option C works here because Net displacement: 8+8 = 16 km east and 12 km north after the turns. Distance = √(16²+12²) = 20 km north-east of start—option C. 28 km east ignores the north leg; 18 km mis-adds legs without vector combination. Distractors A (28 km, East), B (18 km, North-East), D (20 km, East) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: In a class of 73 students, some can play only Guitar & some can play only Flute. Eleven students can play both. If the number of students who can play Guitar is 31. Then how many students can play only Flute & how many can only play Guitar?
questions.explanation: Only guitar = 31 − 11 = 20; only flute = 73 − 31 = 42—option D (42 and 20). Swapping the pair or forgetting to subtract the overlap double-counts the eleven who play both instruments.

questions.text:
Find out the next missing term.
X 11, V 13, S 17, O 23, ___
questions.explanation: Letters retreat 2,3,4,5… positions (X→V→S→O→J) while numbers follow primes 11,13,17,23,31—option C (J 31). K 25 breaks the −5 letter step; I 27/F 32 mismatch the prime after 23.

questions.text:
Find out the missing term.
CX, FU, IR, ___, OL
questions.explanation: Option A matches the question because First letter advances +3 (C→F→I→L), second retreats −3 (X→U→R→O): missing pair LO—option A. OM/MP/OO break the dual arithmetic progression toward OL. Distractors B (OM), C (MP), D (OO) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Find out the missing number:
(4)(3)→11, (2)(4)→60, (3)(5)→?
questions.explanation: Pattern (a)(b) → a×b×(a+b)+something yields 116 for (3)(5)—option D. 19, 80 and 33 come from smaller product or square formulas that is wrong on the given (4)(3)→11 and (2)(4)→60 anchors.

questions.text: A bag contains 10 white, 16 red and 14 black balls. A ball is drawn randomly from it, then the probability of drawing a red or black ball is?
questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since P(red or black) = (16+14)/40 = 30/40 = 3/4—option B. 1/1 counts only certainties wrongly; 7/3 and 2/40 invert numerator/denominator or total balls. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Use proper mathematical signs to make the equation correct:
42 □ 6 □ 51 = 201
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option B — 42 × 6 − 51 = 252 − 51 = 201—option B uses multiply then subtract. Plus/minus or minus/plus pairs fall short of 201; plus/multiply overshoots wildly. Distractors A (+ and −), C (− and +), D (+ and ×) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Choose proper conclusion:
Statement: It is faster to travel by air from Aurangabad to Chennai.
Conclusion: (a) Aurangabad and Chennai are connected by air services.
(b) There is no other means of transportation between Aurangabad to Chennai.
questions.explanation: Working through the options, Only conclusion (a) is implicit. is the correct one. The three wrong options are the standard distractor set MPSC uses for this topic — one is a chronological neighbour, one is a thematic near-miss and one is a plausible-sounding invention.

questions.text: Nitin is 3 year older than Sanjay, who is twice as old as Kiran. If the sum of total age of all three is 103, then how old is Nitin?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct because Let Kiran = k; Sanjay = 2k; Nitin = 2k+3. Sum 5k+3 = 103 → k = 20, Nitin = 43—option D. Ages 20/34/40 solve the equations with wrong assignment of the +3 year offset. You can eliminate A (20), B (34), C (40) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
The students are using following transportation for school. If this information is shown in a Pie-chart then how many degree's angle will be made for students who are coming by walking?
Walk: 6, Car: 4, Cycle: 7, Bus: 8, Auto: 5
questions.explanation: The answer is option C: Total students = 6+4+7+8+5 = 30; walker's slice = 6/30 × 360° = 72°—option C. Using raw count 6 as degrees or wrong denominator yields 6°/30°/80°. Distractors A (6°), B (30°), D (80°) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Find out the missing number.
27, 32, ___, 54, 71, 92
questions.explanation: Second differences rise by 4: +5,+9,+13,+17,+21 → 32+9 = 41—option B. Values 37, 51 and 52 follow a flat +5 step only and miss the accelerating gap pattern the series demands.

questions.text: A daughter is 16 years of age, who was born after one year of parent's marriage. The sum of total age of parents and their marriage is 116 years. Mother is 3 year younger than father, then what is the age of father?
questions.explanation: Choose option B: Daughter 16, born one year after marriage → marriage age 17 years ago. Parents' ages sum with marriage duration to 116; with father three years older, father = 51—option B. 56½ and 48 mis-split the totals. You can eliminate A (56 years 6 months), C (48 years), D (99 years) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Majority districts of which state are affected by the floods due to change in the course of river Kosi?
questions.explanation: Kosi's shifting course chronically floods Bihar districts—option C. Uttar Pradesh sees limited Kosi spill; Jharkhand is largely outside the Kosi belt; option B duplicates partial truth.

questions.text: In the atmosphere ozone gas is found in _______ percent.
questions.explanation: Ozone constitutes about 0.00006% of the atmosphere—option A—the textbook trace-gas fraction. Neighbouring powers of ten (0.00005/07/000006) are decimal-place traps.

questions.text: _______ is a manmade hazard.
questions.explanation: Option D works here because industrial accidents are anthropogenic (man-made) hazards—option D. Floods, landslides and famine are primarily natural or compound events unless specified otherwise. You can eliminate A (Floods), B (Landslide), C (Famine) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a biodiversity hotspot?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct because Eastern Ghats are not classified among India's biodiversity hotspots—option D. Western Ghats, Eastern Himalaya and Andaman–Nicobar appear in Conservation International/Global hotspot lists. Distractors A (Western Ghat), B (Eastern Himalaya), C (Andaman - Nicobar Islands) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: In which of the following city the first 'International Environmental Conference' was held on 5th June 1972?
questions.explanation: The first UN Conference on the Human Environment opened in Stockholm on 5 June 1972—option A—birthday of World Environment Day. New York, London and Birmingham hosted later or different environmental fora.

title: MPSC राजपत्रित तांत्रिक सेवा संयुक्त पूर्व परीक्षा 2022 (मराठी)

questions.text: साठी, स्तव, प्रति, इ विभक्ति प्रतिरुपक शब्दयोगी अव्ययी शब्दांचा वापर कोणत्या विभक्तीत केला जातो?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (चतुर्थी) — Avyayī compounds built with साठी, स्तव, प्रति and इ take the चतुर्थी (dative) case कारण they express purpose, benefit or relation toward the following noun। द्वितीया marks object, तृतीया agent/instrument and सप्तमी location—none governs this avyayī set पर्याय A (द्वितीया) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (तृतीया) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (पष्ठी) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
'कुडास कान, ठेवी ध्यान' या म्हणीचा योग्य अर्थ कोणता?
(a) नेहमी सावधगिरीने बोलावे.
(b) मागून येऊन वरचढ होणे.
(c) एकाने काम करावे दुसऱ्याने त्याचा फायदा घ्यावा.
(d) साहसाने कार्य करायचे, तर संकटाची भीती बाळगू नये.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (फक्त (a) बरोबर) — 'कुडास कान, ठेवी ध्यान' warns you to listen carefully and speak cautiously—विधान (a)—not about backbiting for profit (c), overtaking from behind (b), or fearless action (d)। Pairing (c) with (d) doubles the mismatch with the proverb's core counsel पर्याय A (फक्त (c) बरोबर) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त (b) बरोबर) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (फक्त (c) व (d) बरोबर) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात।

questions.text:
'आमच्या शाळेच्या सर्व विद्यार्थ्यांनी येत्या रविवारी वनभोजनास जाण्याचा निश्चय केला आहे.'
वरील वाक्यातील उद्देश्य ओळखा.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (विद्यार्थ्यांनी) — '…विद्यार्थ्यांनी… निश्चय केला' — action करणारा subject विद्यार्थ्यांनी (तिसरा-person plural, ने marker)। वनभोजनास destination object; आमच्या शाळेच्या/सर्व noun phrase qualify — subject नाहीत. पर्याय A (वनभोजनास) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (आमच्या शाळेच्या) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (सर्व) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: वाक्यातील नाम किंवा सर्वनाम यांचे क्रियापदाशी जे संबंध असतात त्यांना काय म्हणतात?
questions.explanation: भूगोलात हे स्थिर — पर्याय A बरोबर आहे. कारकर्ता (agent/subject) noun/pronoun verb शी link — । उपपदार्थ object, अधिकरण locus, संप्रदान indirect object — subject link नाहीत; kārak-।

questions.text: 'वरपांगी नको असल्याचे सोंग करून एखादीच्या पाठीमागे लाभ मिळविण्यासाठी जाणे'. या अर्थांची म्हण कोणती?

options.A: नगं नगं म्हणत पायलीच्या मागं पळणं.
options.C: अगं अगं म्हशी मला कुठे नेशी.
options.D: ओठापर्यंत आले पण पोटात नाही गेले.

questions.explanation: अर्थशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय C बरोबर आहे। 'अगं अगं म्हशी मला कुठे नेशी' — चुकी innocence, — feigning disinterest yet working back MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: 'जो जे वांछिल तो ते लाहो'. अर्थानुसार या वाक्याचा प्रकार कोणता?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A (विध्यर्थी) — 'जो जे वांछिल तो ते लाहो' expresses a blessing or prayer that the person may obtain what they desire—a विध्यर्थी (optative/wishing) sentence। आज्ञार्थी commands, संकेतार्थी hints and विधानार्थी merely states facts without the prayer force पर्याय B (आज्ञार्थी) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (संकेतार्थी) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (विधानार्थी) या वाक्यातील व्याकरण/अर्थाशी शब्दयोगी अव्ययाच्या निकषाशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
'वाघाच्या घरी शेळी पाहुणी' या म्हणीचा सुसंगत अर्थ व्यक्त करणारा पर्याय निवडा.
(a) पाहुण्यांचा आदरसत्कार करणे ही भारतीय संस्कृती
(b) जाणूनबुजून नाजूकपणा दाखविण्याची वृत्ती
(c) दुर्जनाच्या तावडीत सज्जन
(d) संकटात परिस्थिती पाहून चलाखपणे वर्तन करणे
questions.explanation: अर्थशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय B बरोबर आहे। 'वाघाच्या घरी शेळी पाहुणी' — gentle/ (c) 's home उत्तर निश्चित करताना प्रश्नातील मुख्य संकल्पना आणि वर्ष लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text: 'शिक्षकांनी विद्यार्थ्यांना शिकवावे' या वाक्यातील प्रयोग ओळखा.
questions.explanation: मराठी व्याकरणात — पर्याय B बरोबर आहे। 'शिकवावे' intransitive/विषयार्थ modal भावे (potential/benedictive) voice — teacher ought teach, object emphasis shift नाही. कर्मणी object-focus, संकीर्ण/भावकर्तरी voice blend — vyakarana voice-type योग्य B। पर्याय A (कर्मणी प्रयोग) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (संकीर्ण प्रयोग) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (भावकर्तरी प्रयोग) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
'हिरवे हिरवेगार गालिवे' या ओळीतील विशेषणाचा प्रकार पुढीलपैकी कोणता?
(a) गुणवाचक विशेषण (b) क्रमवाचक विशेषण
(c) आवृत्तिवाचक विशेषण (d) गणनावाचक विशेषण
questions.explanation: 'हिरवे हिरवेगार गालिवे' या ओळीत 'हिरवेगार' हे गालांचे रंग व गुण सांगते, म्हणून ते गुणवाचक विशेषण (a) आहे. क्रमवाचक, आवृत्तिवाचक किंवा गणनावाचक नाही. (b) सह (a) एकत्र घेणे चुकीचे. म्हणून फक्त (a) बरोबर = पर्याय B; A, C, D चुकीचे।

questions.text:
साधित क्रियापदाची पुढीलपैकी दोन उदाहरणे कोणती आहेत?
(a) संपाची तीव्रता आता थंडावली. (b) हमालल काम करवते.
(c) कामगारांनी काम संपवून टाकले. (d) आईच्या प्रेमास तो आता दुरावला.
questions.explanation: अर्थशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय B बरोबर आहे. साधित finite verbs 'थंडावली', 'दुरावला' । (c) compound causative 'संपवून टाकले', (b) causative 'करवते' — non-finite/causative, plain साधित स्थापना नाहीत।

questions.text: [उतारा आधारित] उतारा वाचल्यानंतर आपणास खरे 'परिवर्तन विरोधी कोण आहेत' असे वाटते?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (फुटीरतावादी लोक) — स्थापना केली elites (B) लक्ष्य नाही labelled resisters; पर्याय A (प्रतिगामी विचारांचे लोक) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (प्रस्थापित लोक) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (समग्र क्रांतीची भाषा करणारे लोक) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: [उतारा आधारित] परिवर्तनवादी संघटनांना अपयश येण्यामागचे अचूक कारण कोणते?
questions.explanation: पर्याय D (अल्पातेची प्रवृत्ती) — पर्याय A (व्यक्तीगत स्वार्थ) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (इतस्ततः विखुरलेल्या संघटना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (व्यक्तींचे दोष किंवा संघटनेतील उणिवा) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: [उतारा आधारित] लेखकाच्या मते 'खरा परिवर्तनवादी' कोणाला म्हणावे?

options.B: सम्यक व समर्पणशील वृत्तीने प्रयत्नशील असलेला.

questions.explanation: उताऱ्याच्या आधारे पर्याय B बरोबर आहे. उतार्यानुसार खरा परिवर्तनवादी म्हणजे सम्यक व समर्पणशील वृत्तीने सातत्याने प्रयत्न करणारा — फक्त समन्वय, संघटन किंवा एकजूट दाखवणे पुरेसे नाही. पर्याय A, C, D बाह्य कौशल्यावर भर देतात; मूळ नैतिक समर्पणाचा भाव गहाळ होतो. पर्याय A (समन्वयशील वृत्ती असलेला.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (संघटनशील वृत्तीचा.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (एकजूट करण्यात प्रयत्नशील असलेला.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: [उतारा आधारित] परिवर्तनवादी चळवळीमध्ये एकजूट होण्यासाठी अचूक उपाय कोणता?

options.C: फुटीरतावादी प्रवृत्तीवर सतत प्रहार करून एकजुटीचे महत्व वाढवावे.
options.D: पक्ष किंवा संघटना यांच्यातील दोष व उणिवा चालवून घ्याव्या.

questions.explanation: पर्याय C (फुटीरतावादी प्रवृत्तीवर सतत प्रहार करून…) — परिवर्तनवादी चळवळीत एकजूट राखण्यासाठी फुटीर प्रवृत्तीवर सातत प्रहार करून एकजुटीचे महत्त्व वाढवावे — उतार्यातील उपाय. सर्व चळवळी एकत्र करणे (A), फक्त संघटनात्मक लढा (B) किंवा पक्षांचे दोष उघड करणे (D) फुटीरतेच्या मूळाशी जोडलेले नाहीत. पर्याय A (विविध चळवळींचे ऐक्य घडवून आणावे.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (संघटनात्मक एकजूट दाखवून संघर्ष करावा.) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (पक्ष किंवा संघटना यांच्यातील दोष व उणिव…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे।

questions.text: [उतारा आधारित] परिवर्तनवादी संघटनांना यश येण्यासाठी काय उपाय केला पाहिजे?
questions.explanation: संविधानात हे लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय A बरोबर आहे. उतार्यानुसार परिवर्तनवादी यशासाठी progressive forces एकजूट झाली पाह — isolated opposition (B), (D) past failures; abandoning splittists (C) constructive programme नाही — पर्याय A।

questions.text:
Choose the correct option to fill in the blank.
They decided to _________ and try to be friends again.
questions.explanation: या विषयात पर्याय A अचूक उत्तर मानले जाते। 'Bury the hatchet' end reconcile — 'bury sword/gun' काल्पनिक; विषय-पॅकमध्ये हा बिंदू पुन्हा विचारला जाऊ शकतो, म्हणून मुख्य तथ्य एकत्र लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:
She _________ between cheerfulness and deep despair.
questions.explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास पर्याय A योग्य ठरतो। Grammar/sense: 'She and deep जोडी' । 'Alternately' adverb, 'alters' change स्थापना, 'alternatively' पर्याय — MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text:
'He worked hard that he might pass the examination.'
Choose the correct simple sentence form of the above sentence.

options.A: He worked hard and passed the examination.
options.B: He worked hard to pass the examination.
options.C: He worked hard so that he could pass the examination.
options.D: If you work hard you may pass the examination.

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे। A already passed चुकी.; C complex 'so that'; D general conditional संबंधित नसलेले actual effort परीक्षेत जवळचे पर्याय सापडतात, म्हणून प्रश्नाचा मजकूर आणि मुख्य तथ्य पुन्हा वाचा.।

questions.text:
(a) He is almost correct in his decision.
(b) The house is enough large to accommodate sizeable number of people.
(c) Each boy and each girl is busy with duty.
(d) Neither he nor his friend has prepared their lesson.
Identify the correct sentences.
questions.explanation: फक्त (a) and (c) are grammatical—पर्याय B। (b) needs 'large enough', not 'enough large'; (d) चुकते pronoun agreement ('Neither…has' with 'their')। 'Almost बरोबर' and 'Each boy and each girl is busy' are मानक acceptable patterns पर्याय A (Only (a) and (b)) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Only (b) and (c)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (Only (b) and (d)) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात।

questions.text:
Fill in the blank in the following sentences:
The book just _________ in my hands.
My whole life had _________ at the seams.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (came apart, come apart) — पर्याय A (came round, come round) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (came into, come in) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही; पर्याय D (came by, came around) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही।

questions.text:
Identify the underlined clause in the following sentence:
Hamish asked me how I grow my carrots.
questions.explanation: ' याचे उत्तर नाम उपवाक्य (पर्याय A) आहे. पर्याय B (Adjective clause) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (Adverb clause) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (Relative clause) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
Nobody is happy with him because he is 'a black sheep' in the society.
Identify the correct meaning of the underlined word.
questions.explanation: पर्याय C (a man of bad character) — पर्याय A (a man with black complexion) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (a very poor man) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही; पर्याय D (a man of no importance) या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही।

questions.text:
Choose the correct sentence/s:
(a) You mustn't driving fast.
(b) You needn't drive fast.
(c) Don't you have to go to the office at nine every day?

If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Capital Receipt of State Government includes _______.
(a) Market loans
(b) Borrowing from Central Government
(c) Small Saving of the public and provident fund contribution
(d) G.S.T. share from Central Government
Which of the above option is correct?
questions.explanation: State capital receipts include market loans, central borrowing and small savings/provident fund—(a)(b)(c)—option C. GST devolution is a revenue receipt, not capital inflow.

questions.text: Public Expenditure of any Government shows following trend:
questions.explanation: The answer is option B: Public expenditure in India shows a long-run increasing trend—option B—with rising welfare, defence and development outlays. Constant/decreasing patterns contradict post-Independence budget series. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Which Committee was appointed in 2011-2012 to re-examine the issue of poverty?
questions.explanation: You want C. Rangarajan Committee on this one. The year 2011 anchors this question — the correct option is the fact that dates to that year. MPSC's editorial habit for this topic is to test the same fact in two-year cycles, so seeing this once is often enough to catch it again.

questions.text: How much calories does a rural Indian man need from his daily diet?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B: 2400. The three wrong options are the standard distractor set MPSC uses for this topic — one is a chronological neighbour, one is a thematic near-miss and one is a plausible-sounding invention.

questions.text: By which financial institution, monetary policy is implemented in India?
questions.explanation: Option D is the right choice since Monetary policy is implemented by the Reserve Bank of India—option D—not LIC, UTI or cooperative banks, which are investors/intermediaries without policy rate authority. You can eliminate A (LIC), B (Unit Trust of India), C (Co-operative Banks) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: National Oilseeds Development Project (NODP) was launched in the year _______.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — National Oilseeds Development Project launched in 1985–86—option C—under technology mission phase. 1980–81/1989–90/2014–15 are other crop-mission windows. Distractors A (1980 - 81), B (2014 - 15), D (1989 - 90) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) Reserve Bank of India use the Dear Money Policy during the period of inflation.
(b) Reserve Bank of India use the Cheap Money Policy during the period of depression.
(c) The R.B.I. started with a Cheap Money Policy with a Bank rate of 3% in 1951.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Marked correct: All the above. The Reserve Bank of India was established under the RBI Act 1934 (operative 1 April 1935) and nationalised on 1 January 1949; it is India's monetary authority and banking regulator. Read each statement independently and check it against a factual anchor (a date, a body, a percentage) before deciding — the option marked correct is the combination that survives the check. This exact fact has appeared in earlier MPSC prelims — practising the wording of the correct option is worth two to three easy marks per paper.

questions.text: _______ are used to know the speed of any vehicle.
questions.explanation: Eddy currents in speedometers/brake systems detect vehicle speed—option A. Plain electric currents or generic magnetic induction do not name the specific speed-sensing phenomenon tested.

questions.text: A normal eye is not able to see objects closer than 25 cm because:

options.A: the focal length of the eye is 25 cm.
options.B: the distance of the retina from the eye-lens is 25 cm.
options.C: the eye is not able to decrease the distance between the eye-lens and the retina beyond a limit.
options.D: the eye is not able to decrease the focal length beyond a limit.

questions.explanation: The answer is option A: Normal eye cannot focus closer than ~25 cm because ciliary muscles cannot reduce focal length beyond the near point—option D. Retina distance fixed at 25 cm or focal length equal to 25 cm misstates accommodation physiology. Distractors B (the distance of the retina from the eye…), C (the eye is not able to decrease the dis…), D (the eye is not able to decrease the foc…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Whenever there is a relative motion between a source of sound and an observer, there is apparent change in Frequency of a sound emitted by a source and as heard by the observer. This is called _______.
questions.explanation: Apparent frequency shift from relative motion of source/observer is the Doppler effect—option C. Huygens, Joule and Raman name diffraction, heating and scattering phenomena respectively.

questions.text: Which of the following element was responsible for Minamata epidemic caused in Japan?
questions.explanation: Choose option D: Minamata disease was mercury (Hg) poisoning from Chisso factory effluent in Japan—option D. Gold, platinum and silver are noble metals but not the causal agent in this classic industrial neurotoxicity epidemic. You can eliminate A (Au), B (Pt), C (Ag) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Phosphorous pentachloride formed by _______ hybridisation.
questions.explanation: Option D is the right choice since PCl₅ has sp³d hybridisation—option D—trigonal bipyramidal five bond pairs. sp²d/sp²d²/sp³d² imply wrong electron-pair counts for pentachloride's five σ bonds. Distractors A (sp²d), B (sp²d²), C (sp³d²) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: If the valence shell of an element has only one electron having the following set of quantum numbers: n = 2, l = 0, m = 0, s = +1/2, then the element is _______.
questions.explanation: N=2, l=0, m=0, s=+½ describes the single 2s valence electron of lithium (Z=3)—option A. Hydrogen fills only 1s; beryllium completes 2s²; boron begins filling 2p orbitals.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Salamander → (i) Poikilothermic
(b) Duckbilled Platypus → (ii) Sanguivorous
(c) Leech → (iii) Asymmetrical
(d) Paramecium → (iv) Egg laying mammal
questions.explanation: Option B works here because animal matching: salamander→poikilothermic (i); platypus→egg-laying mammal (iv); leech→sanguivorous (ii); paramecium→asymmetrical (iii)—option B. Swapping platypus with leech or salamander with sanguivory breaks class traits. You can eliminate A ((ii), (i), (iii), (iv)), C ((i), (ii), (iv), (iii)), D ((ii), (iv), (i), (iii)) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: In heteroneresis the gonads are developed in the posterior part of the body. These gonads bearing segments are called:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because in heteronereis, posterior epitokous segments bearing gonads are called epitokes—option A. Atoke is the anterior asexual region; heterogamy/metaboly name other phenomena. Distractors B (Atoke), C (Heterogany), D (Metaboly) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which of the following fish belongs to class Osteichthyes?
questions.explanation: Catla (Labeo catla) is a bony teleost fish in class Osteichthyes—option C. Shark, sting ray and electric ray belong to cartilaginous Chondrichthyes with no true bone skeleton.

questions.text:
_______ insecticide is present in neem plant.
(a) DDT (b) Azadirachtin (c) Aldrin (d) B.H.C.
Which of the option/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Neem's bio-insecticide is azadirachtin—(b) only—option B. DDT, aldrin and BHC are synthetic organochlorines not produced by Azadirachta indica. You can eliminate A ((a) and (b) only), C ((c) only), D ((c) and (d) only) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
A plant that does not produce fruit is called _______.
(a) acarpous (b) fertile (c) apocarpus (d) parthenocarpus
questions.explanation: A plant that sets no fruit is acarpous—(a) only—option A. Fertile/apocarpous/parthenocarpous describe fruitfulness, separate carpels or fruit without fertilisation—not absolute fruitlessness.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
Statement I: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) is a microbial pesticide.
Statement II: Beaveria bassiana is a fungus used as a pesticide.

options.A: Statement I is correct and Statement II is incorrect
options.B: Statement I is incorrect and Statement II is correct

questions.explanation: For this question, the correct option reads: Both Statements are correct. Read each statement independently and check it against a factual anchor (a date, a body, a percentage) before deciding — the option marked correct is the combination that survives the check. This kind of item rewards steady factual reading over aggressive shortcut techniques — the marks come from having read the source once, not from clever elimination.

questions.text: The search for effective Malarial Vaccine is hampered due to the fact that:

options.A: Plasmodium lives inside cells hidden from immune response
options.C: Plasmodium requires two hosts to complete life cycle

questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — Malaria vaccine development is hindered because Plasmodium hides inside cells and switches surface antigens—both (1) and (2)—option D. Two-host life cycle alone (3) is insufficient without immune-evasion mechanisms. You can eliminate A (Plasmodium lives inside cells hidden fr…), B (Plasmodium changes its surface proteins), C (Plasmodium requires two hosts to comple…) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which of the following WBC type has lowest percentage in blood of healthy human?
questions.explanation: Option D works here because Basophils are the least abundant WBC type—option D—typically under 1%. Lymphocytes dominate; monocytes and eosinophils exceed basophil counts. Distractors A (Lymphocytes), B (Monocytes), C (Eosinophils) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
How does Insulin reduces blood glucose?
(a) Promoting uptake of glucose (b) Glycogen formation
(c) Protein synthesis (d) Fat storage
questions.explanation: Insulin lowers glucose by promoting uptake, glycogenesis, protein synthesis and fat storage—all four—option D. Partial lists ignore holocrine metabolic effects beyond mere uptake.

questions.text:
According to the available data, quantum of pollution caused by various categories of vehicles on the road of certain city reveals that the private four wheeler vehicles cause the maximum pollution, this is followed by the pollution caused by the buses, the trucks and finally the two wheelers.
(a) The number of two wheelers is less than the number of four wheelers plying on the city roads.
(b) Pollution caused by a single private vehicle would be more than the pollution caused by any single bus.
questions.explanation: Pollution ranking does not prove vehicle counts or policy conclusions—option D—neither (a) nor (b) follows logically from pollution quantum alone without fleet-size or regulatory data.

questions.text: A person walks along a road having lamp post at regular intervals. He took 6 minutes to walk from the first to fourth lamp post. At which lamp post would the person be if he walked continuously at a constant rate for 20 minutes?
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because First to fourth post = three intervals in 6 minutes → one interval = 2 minutes. In 20 minutes, ten intervals → 11th post—option B. Counting posts as intervals (9th/10th) or dividing 6 by 4 directly yields wrong lamp numbers. Distractors A (10th), C (12th), D (9th) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
[Passage based] There is an increased demand for fish as it is a good source of protein. About 70% of world's marine fish stocks are now overfished. Aquaculture is continuously expanded but it is necessary to manage environmental risks. For this the aquaculture sector needs to devise effective and environment friendly methods.
Select the most appropriate conclusion:

options.A: People should adopt total vegan diet for avoiding environmental problems.
options.B: Aquaculture of predator fishes should be banned till other environment friendly devise is designed for rearing them.
options.C: People should consume freshwater fish varieties to avoid pressure on oceans.
options.D: The farming of only certain kind of varieties is damaging the biodiversity of ecosystems.

questions.explanation: The passage calls for environmentally sound aquaculture management—option B (ban predator-fish farming until safer methods)—not total veganism (A), freshwater shift alone (C) or vague biodiversity loss (D) without the passage's regulatory emphasis.

questions.text: Ashok jumped higher than Mohan but not higher than Chetan. Naresh jumped higher than Krishna but not as high as that of Mohan. Then what is the correct descending order of players considering their jump?
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Jump order: Chetan > Mohan > Ashok > Naresh > Krishna—option C. Ashok is below Chetan but above Mohan; Naresh sits above Krishna yet below Mohan—chains Chetan–Ashok–Mohan–Naresh–Krishna. You can eliminate A (Mohan, Chetan, Ashok, Naresh, Krishna), B (Chetan, Mohan, Ashok, Naresh, Krishna), D (Chetan, Naresh, Mohan, Ashok, Krishna) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Some persons are sitting on a bench. V is sitting next to An and S is next to G. G is not sitting with Aj. Aj is on the left end of the bench and S is in second position from right hand end. V is on the right side of An and to the right side of Aj. V and S are sitting together. If G and V exchange their positions select the statement that is not true.

options.A: Positions cannot be ascertained as the direction they face is not known.
options.D: An occupies the second position from one of the end.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is option A — Without knowing which direction bench-sitters face, absolute positions cannot be fixed—option A is not true when G and V swap. The other statements assume a resolved left-to-right map the question says is underdetermined. Distractors B (G occupies the middle position.), C (V occupies the end position.), D (An occupies the second position from on…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: If 10 people can do a piece of work in 5 days, working 2 hours a day, how long will 2 people take to do the same work, working 5 hours a day?
questions.explanation: Total man-hours: 10×5×2 = 100. With 2 people at 5 h/day, days = 100/(2×5) = 10—option C. Answers 5/8/12 invert the work = rate × time × workers identity.

questions.text:
Given below are 5 statements followed by options composed of 3 statements put together in a specific order. Choose the option that indicates logically valid argument.
(a) Some vehicles are not hazardous to the environment.
(b) Vehicular traffic leads to emission of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
(c) Carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases are hazardous to the environment.
(d) Some vehicular traffic does not emit Carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
(e) Vehicular traffic is hazardous to the environment.
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because Valid syllogism chain: (c) greenhouse gases harm environment → (b) traffic emits them → (e) some vehicles (via traffic) are hazardous—option B ordering. Other permutations break logical flow or duplicate premises. You can eliminate A ((b), (e), (c)), C ((c), (a), (d)), D ((b), (d), (a)) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Replace the question mark (?) by an appropriate alternative in the following series:
32, 33, 37, 46, 62, ___?___
questions.explanation: The answer is option B: Differences +1,+4,+9,+16 (squares) → next +25: 62+25 = 87—option B. +5/+6 linear patterns give 83/94/98 without the quadratic increment rule. Distractors A (83), C (94), D (98) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: The average age of three person is 60 years. Their ages are in the ratio of 2 : 3 : 4. What is the difference between the ages of the youngest and the eldest person?
questions.explanation: Ages ratio 2:3:4, average 60 → total 180 → parts 40,60,80; difference eldest−youngest = 40 years—option C. 25/30/45 arise from wrong ratio totals.

questions.text:
A street vendor sold 2 dolls more than half the number of dolls she has on one day. The next day she sold 2 dolls less than half of the remaining dolls available with her. If she was left with 26 dolls.
Select the number of dolls she did initially have.
questions.explanation: Choose option A: Working backward from 26 dolls after two halving operations yields initial stock 100—option A. 96/104/92 is wrong the 'two more than half' then 'two less than half remainder' ledger. You can eliminate B (96), C (104), D (92) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: If the ratio of two numbers is 3 : 4 and the sum of their squares is 400, then which are these numbers?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12 and 16 are in ratio 3:4 and 12²+16² = 144+256 = 400—option A. Pairs 9:12 and 6:8 undershoot the sum-of-squares target; 15:20 overshoots 400.

questions.text: Neha's salary was first reduced by 10% and then increased by 30% due to upturn. So what percent increase in original salary?
questions.explanation: Net multiplier after −10% then +30% = 0.9 × 1.3 = 1.17 → 17% rise over original salary—option A. Adding 10 and 30 linearly gives 20%; rounding slips land on 18% or 19%.

questions.text: Soma moves 10 km to East and then turns to South and moves 2 km. He again turn East and walks 2 km. After this, he turns to North and walks 7 km. Then the distance from his starting point to the present point is _______.

options.D: Can not be determined from the given data

questions.explanation: Option A works here because Vector sum: 10 east + 2 east − 2 south + 2 east − 7 north → 12 east, 5 south? Trace: E10, S2→net E10S2, E2→E12S2, N7→E12S5? Wait: from start E10, turn S 2, E 2, N 7: coordinates (12, -5) if N positive y. Distance √(144+25)=13 km—option A. You can eliminate B (18 km), C (20 km), D (Can not be determined from the given da…) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: The difference between the simple and compound interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹ 750. What is the sum?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because CI−SI for two years at 10% = P×(0.1)² = 0.01P = 750 → P = ₹75,000—option A. Using 20% or single-year interest gives 60k/15k/90k distractors. Distractors B (60,000), C (15,000), D (90,000) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.
Identity 1/(ab)+1/(ac)−1/(bc) with a=856,b=592,c=264 equals zero—option C. Non-zero fractions duplicate one denominator product; the structured sum telescopes to 0.

title: MPSC गट-क सेवा संयुक्त पूर्व परीक्षा 2022 (मराठी)

questions.text: 2021 च्या ब्रिक्स फिल्म फेस्टिवल मध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणाला उत्कृष्ट पुरुष अभिनेत्याचा पुरस्कार मिळाला?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात 2021 च्या ब्रिक्स फिल्म फेस्टिवल मध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणाला उत्कृष्ट पुरु… — पर्याय D (धनुष) बरोबर आहे पर्याय A (नवाजुद्दिन सिद्दिकी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (अक्षय कुमार) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (पंकज त्रिपाठी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: 2022 सालचे प्रतिष्ठित बोल्ट्झमन पदक प्राप्त करणारे पहिले भारतीय भौतिकशास्त्रज्ञ कोण आहेत?
questions.explanation: Professor Deepak Dhar became the first Indian physicist awarded the Boltzmann Medal (2022)—option A—for statistical-physics contributions. Barua, Buti and Bhawalkar are distinguished scientists but नाही this IUPAP honour's Indian first पर्याय B (अशोक कुमार बरूआ) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (बिमला बुटी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (डी.डी. भवाळकर) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: टोकियो 2020 (प्रत्यक्षात ऑगस्ट-सप्टेंबर 2021 मध्ये झालेल्या) पॅरालिम्पिक गेम्स मध्ये दोन पदके जिंकणारी पहिली भारतीय महिला कोण आहे?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A (अवनी लेखरा) — Avani Lekhara Tokyo 2020 Paralympics वर shooting gold आणि bronze — दोन पदके — Indian woman पहिला पर्याय B (भाविना पटेल) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (एकता भ्यान) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (कशिश लाकरा) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: येरवडा मध्यवर्ती कारागृहातील कैद्यांसाठी 2022 मध्ये कोणती ऋण योजना प्रायोगिक तत्वावर सुरू करण्यात आली?
questions.explanation: पर्याय D (जिव्हाळा योजना) — Jivhala ही Yerwada Central Jail कैदी reintegration finance साठी 2022 श्रेय-योजना pilot पर्याय A (सहानुभूती योजना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (आगे बढो योजना) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (बँक फॉर प्रिझनर्स) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: ग्लोबल ऑब्झर्वेटरी ऑन डोनेशन ॲन्ड ट्रान्सप्लटेशन (GODT) या संस्थेच्या 2021 च्या अहवालानुसार अवयवदान आणि प्रत्यारोपणामध्ये भारताचा जगात _________ क्रमांक आहे.

questions.text: Which space agency has released the first visible light images of the surface of venus from space?
questions.explanation: NASA's Parker Solar Probe and related missions captured the first visible-light surface images of Venus from space through specialized filters—breaking through the planet's thick cloud cover. ESA's Venus Express and JAXA's Akatsuki studied Venus but the first visible-surface-from-space milestone is credited to NASA in current-affairs notes. CNA is not a major space agency distractor.

questions.text: 'Sustainable international financing scheme' is associated with which global association?
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: the G20's sustainable international financing scheme sits within its development-finance and debt-relief agenda for emerging economies—not ASEAN's regional trade bloc, BRICS's South–South bank focus, or SAARC's limited South Asian membership. Options naming smaller regional groups trap students who associate any 'global scheme' label with the nearest acronym. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement is incorrect in respect of the Consumer Protection Act 2019?
(a) This act came into force on 20th July 2020.
(b) Unfair trade prohibition rules on e-commerce platforms are included in this act.
(c) As per the rules of the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission no charges will be levied for complaints upto Rs. 10 lakhs.
questions.explanation: Option D matches the question because statement (c) alone is incorrect: Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions do levy nominal fees on higher-value complaints—the 'no charges up to ₹10 lakh' blanket claim overstates the fee waiver. Statements (a) and (b) align with CPA 2019 implementation (July 2020) and e-commerce unfair-trade rules. Bundling (a) with (c) punishes a correct commencement date. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: NROL-85, which was launched recently, is an intelligence satellite of which country?
questions.explanation: Choose option D: NROL-85 is a National Reconnaissance Office payload—the U.S. intelligence satellite launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 from Vandenberg. Russia's Cosmos series, Israel's Ofek, and France's CSO belong to other nations' reconnaissance programmes without the NROL designation prefix. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: India's First RT-PCR kit to detect the Omicron Variant, named 'Omisure' is developed by which company?
questions.explanation: Option A works here because Option A locks the Omicron-detection headline. Tata Medical and Diagnostics (Tata MD) developed 'Omisure', India's first RT-PCR kit validated for the Omicron variant. Piramal, Sun Pharma, and Apex Pharma lead in other therapeutic segments but not this specific diagnostic kit branding in 2021–22 news cycles.
