questions.explanation: Option D matches the question because Tatsam Sanskrit loans: 'Pad, dugdh, graas' (step, milk, morsel) and 'Karna, aranya, jal' (ear, forest, water)—groups (a) and (k). 'Ghar, haat, gaav' are deshi/tadbhav everyday words—not tatsam—exclude (b). Distractors A (Fakat a), B (Fakat b), C (Fakat a va b) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Vaakyaateel kriyaapadachya roopavaroon keval kaalaachaa bodh hot asel tar tyaalaa _______ vaakya mhanataat.
questions.explanation: When only tense is inferred from verb form without mood/intent, the sentence is svaarthee (literal tense statement)—not kaalavaachan (time adverb), vidhaanaarthee (imperative), or sanketaarth (figurative). Pure temporal reporting = svaarthee.

questions.text:
"It is extremely hot today."
The underlined word is:
questions.explanation: 'Extremely' modifies degree/intensity of 'hot'—adverb of degree. Not manner (how), frequency (how often), or affirmation (yes/no emphasis)—intensifier before adjective marks degree.

questions.text: Identify the sentence written in correct passive voice.

options.A: Peter was taught to sing by Mr. Price.
options.B: Tim was started to respect by his colleagues.
options.C: I enjoyed taking the children to the zoo.
options.D: They saw him climbing over the fence.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is option A — Correct passive: 'Peter was taught to sing by Mr. Price'—proper be + past participle + agent. (B) 'was started to respect' is ungrammatical; (C) is active enjoyment; (D) is active perception, not passive transformation. Distractors B (Tim was started to respect by his colle…), C (I enjoyed taking the children to the zo…), D (They saw him climbing over the fence.) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
"The Sun has ripened the fruit."
Which one of the following is the Passive Structure corresponding to the Active Voice structure above?
questions.explanation: Present perfect active 'The Sun has ripened the fruit' → passive 'The fruit has been ripened by the Sun'—(a) only = option (D). Other sub-options in the paper use wrong tense or miss agent/by-phrase alignment.

questions.text: The verb form of the given noun word "Frost" will be:
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because Noun 'frost' (ice deposit) relates to verb 'freeze'—same cold-solidification root. 'Defrost' removes frost; 'foster' nurtures; 'fructify' bears fruit—etymologically and semantically 'freeze' pairs with frost formation. You can eliminate A (Defrost), C (Foster), D (Fructify) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Identify the correct conditional sentence.

options.A: If he left his bicycle, someone will steal it.
options.B: If you try again, you would succeed.
options.C: If he had written the letter, I'll post it.
options.D: If we had found him earlier, we could have saved his life.

questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Third conditional: 'If we had found him earlier, we could have saved his life'—past unreal condition + past modal result. (A–C) mix tenses (will/would/I'll) breaking conditional sequence rules. Distractors A (If he left his bicycle, someone will st…), B (If you try again, you would succeed.), C (If he had written the letter, I'll post…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
"None of us knew the way, _______"
The correct tag-question for the sentence above is:
questions.explanation: 'None of us knew the way, did we?'—positive tag after negative 'none' with past 'knew' needs 'did we?' (c only = B). 'Didn't we' wrongly positive; 'did none/didn't anyone' are malformed tags.

questions.text:
"The dog that barks does not bite."
The underlined words are:
questions.explanation: Choose option A: 'That barks' restricts 'dog'—adjective (relative) clause modifying noun. It does not adverbially modify 'bite'; not a noun clause substitute; standard restrictive relative = adjective clause. You can eliminate B (Adverb clause), C (Noun clause), D (None of the above) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Which one of the following is the one-word substitute of the given sentence.
"A decision which cannot be altered or withdrawn."
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Irrevocable = cannot be changed or withdrawn—fits irrevocable decision. Inexplicable = cannot explain; inaudible = cannot hear; illicit = unlawful—only irrevocable matches irreversible commitment. Distractors A (Inexplicable), B (Inaudible), D (Illicit) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
The word "Sanguine" is synonymous with the word _______.
a. Serious  b. Sadistic  c. Optimistic  d. Genuine
questions.explanation: The intended answer is c only. This kind of item rewards steady factual reading over aggressive shortcut techniques — the marks come from having read the source once, not from clever elimination.

questions.text:
Adversities provoke one to _______ one's best efforts.
Select the correct alternative to complete the sentence meaningfully.
questions.explanation: Option A works here because adversities provoke one to 'put forth' best efforts—bring forward exertion. 'Put back' delays; 'put off' postpones; 'put up' tolerates or erects—collocation demands 'put forth' with effort. You can eliminate B (put back), C (put off), D (put up) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom underlined in the following sentence.
She is leading a dog's life as her husband is an alcoholic and without a job.
questions.explanation: 'Lead a dog's life' = miserable, wretched existence—alcoholic unemployed husband context. Other sub-options in paper (luxury, idle, etc.) miss hardship; (a) only = life of misery.

questions.text:
They have a huge reserve of latent talent.
Identify the correct meaning of the underlined word.
questions.explanation: Latent = hidden, undeveloped, unseen potential—not modern, latest, or admirable as primary meaning. Talent 'in reserve' not yet displayed keys 'unseen'.

questions.text:
Match the following pairs:
a. Eccentric - I. A person who believes in God
b. Infallible - II. A man of strange habits
c. Fanatic - III. A person who cannot make any mistakes
d. Theist - IV. A person with narrow religious views
questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because Word match: Eccentric–strange habits (II); Infallible–cannot err (III); Fanatic–narrow religious zeal (IV); Theist–believes in God (I)—order II, III, IV, I = (C). Theist/fanatic swap is the common trap. You can eliminate A (IV, III, II, I), B (III, II, IV, I), D (III, IV, II, I) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Select the alternative with the words spelt correctly.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — Option (C) spells all correctly: attendance, calendar, detergent, emperor. (A) attendence/challange/antena; (B) begar/ceilling/cliants; (D) sanitery/matirial—multiple errors in each distractor row. Distractors A (attendence, challange, antena, deficient), B (begar, ceilling, cliant, bravery), D (independent, sanitery, neighbour, matir…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
"I always see eye to eye with my sister."
The underlined idiom in the sentence above means:
questions.explanation: 'See eye to eye' = agree completely—correct (d) only in paper's sub-option numbering (C). Not merely support or partial agreement—full agreement idiom; other lettered sub-clauses in source were wrong senses.

questions.text:
(Passage on EV/Connected Mobility) The passage shows that
a. digital connectivity experts are concerned with vehicle users and consumers.
b. manufacturers of motors and motorcycles are thinking of increasing their customers.
c. the OEMs can easily adapt connected mobility.
d. it is easy for the government to promote electric mobility.
questions.explanation: Passage on connected mobility: experts focus on vehicle users/consumers (a)—not OEM ease (c), OEM customer chase alone (b), or easy government EV promotion (d). User-centric connectivity concern is the extract's thrust.

questions.text:
(Passage on EV/Connected Mobility) The integrated system of transportation should mainly think of
a. advancements in battery technology and power devices.
b. data transfer and data analysis.
c. modem for Connectivity and Bluetooth or Wi-Fi link.
d. Safety and experience of vehicle users.
questions.explanation: Option D works here because integrated transport must prioritise safety and user experience (d)—passage emphasises passenger trust over raw battery specs (a), data plumbing alone (b), or modem hardware alone (c). Distractors A (b only), B (c only), C (Both a and d) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: (Passage on EV/Connected Mobility) Vehicle users are reluctant to use electric vehicles because

options.C: c only (concerned with cost of EVs and range)

questions.explanation: The definitive answer is c only (concerned with cost of EVs and range). The three wrong options are the standard distractor set MPSC uses for this topic — one is a chronological neighbour, one is a thematic near-miss and one is a plausible-sounding invention.

questions.text:
(Passage on EV/Connected Mobility) One of the challenges discussed in the passage is about
a. how to integrate various features for connectivity.
b. how the vehicle user will access information about his geoposition.
c. how the government will promote electric mobility.
d. who will pay the maintenance cost of backend infrastructure.
questions.explanation: The answer is option B: Backend infrastructure maintenance cost—who pays—is the passage's fiscal challenge (d). GPS access (b), government promotion (c), or feature integration (a) are secondary to sustainability of connected services funding. You can eliminate A (c only), C (a only), D (b only) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: (Passage on EV/Connected Mobility) The phrase 'by leaps and bounds' used in the passage means:
questions.explanation: Option C matches the question because 'By leaps and bounds' = very rapidly, dramatic growth—(c) only. Literal jumps/limits (a,b) are folk etymology traps; idiom means fast progress in EV/tech context. Distractors A (b only (by jumps and limits)), B (d only), D (a only) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
"He knows how to break in horses."
The underlined idiom in the sentence above means:
questions.explanation: 'Break in horses' = train/discipline horses to accept rider—(c) discipline in paper's key (B). Not stop, mere control without training sense, or hold by force—breaking is taming/training collocation.

questions.text:
"The boy who is wearing a green shirt is my student."
In the given sentence, the underlined words describe:
questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since 'Who is wearing a green shirt' modifies 'boy'—adjective (relative) clause. Restrictive description of noun, not adverb clause of time/place, not noun clause as subject. You can eliminate A (Noun clause), B (Adverb clause), D (Both Noun and Adverb clauses) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
"Shall I buy a scooter?"
The modal in the sentence above has been used to express:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — 'Shall I buy a scooter?'—'Shall I' seeks permission/approval from listener—(c). Not promise, bare suggestion without question form, or third-party advice—first-person shall-question = permission seeking. Distractors A (d only (giving advice)), B (b only (suggestion)), D (a only (promise)) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: "She has been missing _______ Monday last."
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because 'Missing since Monday last'—point starting point in past still relevant uses 'since'. 'For' needs duration phrase; 'from' non-standard here; 'during' needs event noun, not day name. questions.text: All districts of Maharashtra are divided into _______ administrative divisions.
questions.explanation: Maharashtra has six revenue divisions—Konkan, Nashik, Pune, Aurangabad, Amravati, Nagpur—not five/seven/three. Post-2016 names persist with six administrative division count in MPSC geography.

b. West Bengal - II. Gandhisagar

questions.text: Which administrative division has the highest number of districts in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: Choose option A: aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) division carries the most districts in Maharashtra—eight-plus after splits. You can eliminate B (Pune), C (Konkan), D (Nagpur) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. questions.text: Arrange the coal fields of India from North to South in the proper sequence.

options.A: Ranchi, Hazaribagh, Wardha Valley, Godavari Valley

options.D: Godavari Valley, Wardha Valley, Ranchi, Hazaribagh

questions.explanation: Option C is the right choice since Coalfields north→south: Hazaribagh, Ranchi (Jharkhand belt), Wardha Valley, Godavari Valley—(C). Godavari/Wardha first reverses latitude; Ranchi before Hazaribagh misorders Jharkhand fields. questions.text: Tarapur nuclear power station is located in _______ taluka of Palghar district.
questions.explanation: The examination key marks Palghar as the correct choice. Tarapur Atomic Power Station in Palghar district houses two BWR-1 units from 1969 and two 540 MW indigenous PHWRs (2005–06), totalling ~1,400 MW. Add this correct option to your active-recall flashcard deck; MPSC repeats the underlying fact in some form every two to three prelim cycles.

questions.text:
Examine the following statements and choose the correct option.

Statement B: In Tibet, river Brahmaputra is known as 'Dihang' and in Arunachal Pradesh, as 'Tsangpo'.

options.B: Statement A is correct and Statement B is wrong.

questions.text:
Examine the following statements and choose the correct option.

options.B: Statement A is correct and Statement B is wrong.

questions.text:

questions.text: Cluster settlements are found in _______ area of Maharashtra.
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Cluster/nucleated villages dominate Deccan Plateau black-soil tract—rectangular patterns around wells/tanks. Konkan is dispersed hamlets; Ghat tops sparse; Eastern Vidarbha tribal scatter differs. You can eliminate A (Konkan), C (Western Ghat top), D (Hilly areas of Eastern Vidarbha) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Match the pair of Column A (Peak) and Column B (Districts):
a. Astambha - I. Ahmednagar
b. Salher - II. Amravati
c. Chikhaldara - III. Nandurbar
d. Harishchandragad - IV. Nashik
questions.explanation: Choose option D: Peaks: Salher–Nandurbar (III); Chikhaldara–Amravati (II); Harishchandragad–Nashik (IV); Astambha mapped to Ahmednagar in key grid (III, IV, II, I) = (D)—verify Salher-Nandurbar, Chikhaldara-Amravati, Harishchandragad-Nashik, Astambha-Ahmednagar pairing. questions.text:
Which essential conditions have been suggested by WTO for globalization?
a. No limit of geographical boundary for trade
b. Free capital movement
c. Free flow of technology
d. Free international movement of labour
questions.explanation: WTO globalisation conditions include free trade across borders (a), capital mobility (b), technology flow (c), and labour movement (d)—all four limbs in syllabus framing. Partial triples miss labour or technology leg.

questions.text: The 1993-94 budget had reduced the maximum rate of import duty from 110 percent to _______ percent.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — 1993–94 budget cut peak import duty from 110% to 85%—LPG tariff reform milestone. 30% is post later; 95/75 are intermediate distractors near the decade's glide path. You can eliminate A (30), B (95), D (75) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Which things are expected in the privatization process?
a. To open public sector for private investment
b. Free trade policy
c. Special Economic Zone
d. Government industry ownership transfer to private sector
questions.explanation: Option A works here because Privatisation core: open PSU to private investment (a) and transfer ownership to private sector (d)—not every item equals privatisation; free trade (b) and SEZ (c) are parallel reforms. Key (A) a and d only. Distractors B (a, b and c only), C (b and c only), D (All of the above) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: India's Foreign Exchange Reserve was _______ in June 1991.
questions.explanation: Correct: option A — "1.1 billion dollars". The year 1991 anchors this question — the correct option is the fact that dates to that year. Aspirants who miss this item usually pick a nearby-sounding option; the fix is to read the stem twice before scanning the options.

questions.text: _______ deals in procurement, distribution, export and import of selected agricultural commodities.
questions.explanation: The answer is option A: NAFED (National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation) procures/trades select agri commodities—cooperative marketing apex. FCI is foodgrain; NCDC is cooperative development credit; SIDBI is small industries. You can eliminate B (FCI), C (NCDC), D (SIDBI) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Under the Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation (LPG) Policy, Government of India allowed 100 percent FDI in _______ sector.
questions.explanation: 100% FDI allowed in a,b,c sectors per paper list (telecom, mining, etc.—exact labels in source)—option (D) a,b,c only excludes (d). Key bundles three eligible sectors without the fourth distractor sector.

questions.text: The Headquarter of World Trade Organization is at _______.
questions.explanation: WTO headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland—not Paris/London/Moscow. GATT/WTO has been Geneva-based since multilateral trade rounds consolidated there.

questions.text: Due to fall in dollar value of exports by 1.5 percent in 1991-92, the exports grew by over _______ percent in 1993-94.
questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since Export growth exceeded 20% in 1993–94 despite 1.5% dollar value fall in 1991–92 base effect—rupee depreciation and volume expansion drove rebound. 10/30/40 misstate Commerce Ministry compilations for that recovery year. questions.text:

c. Efficiency

Single-limb picks overlook the reform bundle. Distractors A (a only), B (b and d only), C (a and c only) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. questions.text: The Government hands over the PSU's to private sector, which means _______.

questions.text: Which of the following statements is incorrect about Legislative Council?

questions.text: Which of the following Amendment Act of the Indian Constitution added provisions mainly regarding Panchayats?

questions.text: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule has praised the three basics of Liberty, Equality and Universal Brotherhood in his book _______.

questions.text:

questions.text: Arrange the coal fields of India from North to South in the proper sequence.

options.A: Ranchi, Hazaribagh, Wardha Valley, Godavari Valley
options.B: Godavari Valley, Wardha Valley, Hazaribagh, Ranchi
options.C: Hazaribagh, Ranchi, Wardha Valley, Godavari Valley
options.D: Godavari Valley, Wardha Valley, Ranchi, Hazaribagh

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Hazaribagh, Ranchi, Wardha Valley, Godavari Valley. The Godavari, the longest river of the Deccan (~1,465 km, ~668 km in Maharashtra), rises at Brahmagiri near Trimbakeshwar (Nashik) and drains eastward into the Bay of Bengal. The Wardha river rises in Betul (MP) and joins the Wainganga at Sironcha to form the Pranhita, a major tributary of the Godavari. The three incorrect options are close-sounding distractors; anchoring on the exact keyword in the stem eliminates them in seconds.

Savarkar, Roy, and Shyamji belong to later revolutionary or reform phases. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Who started the self-reliant scheme called 'Earn and Learn' for the education of poor children?
(a) Dr. Babasaheb Ambedker and Mahatma Phule
(b) Mahatma Phule
(c) Maharshi Shinde and Agarkar
(d) Karmaveer Bhaurao Patil
questions.explanation: Karmaveer Bhaurao Patil alone started Earn-and-Learn at Rayat Shikshan Sanstha—work-study for poor students. Phule/Ambedkar/Agar-Shinde pairs did different education/social reforms without Patil's branded scheme.

questions.text: What is sex ratio of 0 to 6 age group population in Maharashtra as per the census 2011?
questions.explanation: The official Set A key selects 894. Census 2011 was India's 15th census (7th after independence); it recorded India's population at 121.09 crore and Maharashtra's at 11.24 crore. India's sex ratio per Census 2011 was 943 females per 1,000 males; Maharashtra's was 929. In MPSC PYQ analysis, this item type accounts for the largest cluster of 'easy marks lost due to misreading' — slow down the stem, and the option leaps out.

questions.text: Which is the second tallest mountain peak in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: Option C works here because Kalsubai is highest; Salher (~1567 m) is second tallest peak in Maharashtra—correct second after Kalsubai. Torna and Ghodav are lower Sahyadri forts/hills; Salher in Nashik district holds silver rank. Distractors A (Kalsubai), B (Torna), D (Ghodav) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: According to the 2011 census, which of the following district has highest female literacy?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked Amaravati as the correct response. The year 2011 anchors this question — the correct option is the fact that dates to that year. The three wrong options are the standard distractor set MPSC uses for this topic — one is a chronological neighbour, one is a thematic near-miss and one is a plausible-sounding invention.

questions.text: Which is the first hydropower station in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Khopoli (Tata Hydro, 1927) was Maharashtra's first major hydropower station—Bhivpuri/Khopoli scheme on Ulhas. Koyna and Radhanagari came later; Veer is a smaller project name distractor. You can eliminate A (Veer), B (Radhanagari), C (Koyna) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Which industrial region of India is known as 'Ruhr of India'?
questions.explanation: Option D matches the question because Chota Nagpur Plateau—coal–iron core—is called 'Ruhr of India' for heavy industry density. Kolkata-Hooghly, Ahmedabad-Vadodara, and Madurai-Coimbatore-Bengaluru are other industrial regions without Ruhr nickname. Distractors A (Kolkata - Hooghly Industrial Region), B (Ahmedabad - Vadodara Industrial Region), C (Madurai - Coimbatore - Bengaluru Indust…) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Match the pair:
District → Project
(a) Satara → (i) Natuwadi
(b) Amaravati → (ii) Savali
(c) Hingoli → (iii) Aandhali
(d) Ratnagiri → (iv) Shahanur
questions.explanation: "(iii), (iv), (ii), (i)" is what the question is looking for. The correct pairing above matches every column-A entry with its column-B partner as marked in the official key. Options like this one recur in MPSC papers with only the option-order shuffled, so recognising the anchor phrase in the stem is what carries the mark.

questions.text:
Match the pair:
Sanctuary → Place
(a) Tansa → (i) Jalgaon
(b) Yawal → (ii) Thane
(c) Maldhok → (iii) Solapur
(d) Nagzira → (iv) Gondiya
questions.explanation: Option A is the right choice since Sanctuary match: Tansa–Thane (ii), Yawal–Jalgaon (i), Maldhok–Solapur (iii), Nagzira–Gondia (iv)—a-ii,b-i,c-iii,d-iv. Tansa is Thane/Palghar belt; Yawal in Jalgaon—not swapped. You can eliminate B ((ii), (iii), (i), (iv)), C ((i), (ii), (iii), (iv)), D ((iv), (iii), (ii), (i)) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: As per census 2011, which of the following districts has high population?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option B — Jalgaon district had the highest population among Aurangabad, Nanded, and Yavatmal in 2011—large north Maharashtra demography. Aurangabad and Nanded are big but Jalgaon tops this comparison quartet. Distractors A (Aurangabad), C (Nanded), D (Yeotmal) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which of the following is the correct descending order of the places in Maharashtra according to annual rainfall?
questions.explanation: Rainfall descending: Amboli (highest), Mahabaleshwar, Matheran, Lonavala—coastal Ghats beat interior hill stations. Lonavala leeward of heavy belt ranks last; Amboli's Konkan catch tops state station averages.

questions.text: What are the types of rural settlements in Bundelkhand region?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct because Bundelkhand's rocky, dissected plateau favours dispersed/isolated farm hamlets—not nucleated circular or compact villages. Semi-compact appears in fertile plains; dispersion is the textbook Bundelkhand settlement type. You can eliminate A (Circular Settlements), C (Compact Settlements), D (Semi-compact Settlements) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Protected area of Melghat Tiger Project has been declared as a _______ national park.
questions.explanation: Melghat Tiger Reserve core includes Gugamal National Park—Amravati district. Sanjay Gandhi (Madhya Pradesh border), Chandoli, and Priyadarshini Pench are other protected areas—not Melghat's named NP.

questions.text: Which dam and its reservoir is known as Wilson dam and Aurthar Lake respectively?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked Bhandardara dam as the correct response. The Bhandardara / Wilson Dam on the Pravara in Ahmadnagar is one of India's oldest concrete dams (1926). Aspirants who miss this item usually pick a nearby-sounding option; the fix is to read the stem twice before scanning the options.

questions.text:
What are the causes of soil erosion in India?
(a) Deforestation
(b) Destruction of grasslands
(c) Shifting agriculture
(d) Wrong methods of cultivation
questions.explanation: Choose option D: all four cause soil erosion in India—deforestation, grassland destruction, shifting cultivation, and unsuitable tillage. Picking only one or a partial subset under-counts the standard NCERT erosion bundle. You can eliminate A (Only (a)), B ((a) and (b)), C ((b), (c) and (d)) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Assam has the largest reservoirs of _______ in India.
questions.explanation: Option A is the right choice since assam (Upper Assam basin) holds India's largest onshore oil reserves—Digboi-Naharkatiya belt. Iron, coal, and 'none' miss the Assam oil dominance tested in mineral-distribution MCQs. Distractors B (Iron ore), C (Coal), D (None of above) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/s is/are incorrect?
(a) Chikhaldara is a hill station and located in Satpuda mountain range.
(b) Gavilgad and Melghat mountains are found in southern part of Maharashtra state.
(c) Balaghat mountains are found to the north of Shambhu Mahadev mountain ranges.
questions.explanation: Statement (b) alone is incorrect: Gavilgad–Melghat lies in eastern/northern Maharashtra (Amravati–Chikhaldara), not 'southern part'. (a) Chikhaldara in Satpuda and (c) Balaghat north of Shambhu Mahadev are accepted.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) Absolute poverty can be eradicated.
(b) Relative poverty is based on comparison of lower income group with higher income group.
(c) Poverty is not responsible for degradation of environment.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The correct choice is "(a) and (b)". Read each statement independently and check it against a factual anchor (a date, a body, a percentage) before deciding — the option marked correct is the combination that survives the check. The safest way to lock this item into recall is to write the correct option next to its associated year or body in your revision notebook and skim it weekly.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/s is/are incorrect?
(a) Currency notes in circulation are issued by the Government of India.
(b) Narrow money or M1 includes currency with the public.
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because only (a) is incorrect: currency notes are issued by RBI under Government authorisation—not 'issued by Government of India' alone. (b) correctly defines narrow money M1 including currency with public. Distractors B (Only (b)), C (Both (a) and (b)), D (None of the above) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
The implementation of SGSY is done by:
(a) Commercial Bank
(b) Regional Rural Bank
(c) Co-operative Bank
(d) Foreign Bank
questions.explanation: SGSY (Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana, later absorbed into NRLM) routed self-help group credit through commercial banks, regional rural banks, and cooperative banks—the domestic last-mile network. Foreign banks sat outside this rural livelihood delivery model, so option C correctly bundles (a), (b), and (c) while (d) is excluded.

questions.text: What kind of unemployment arises due to the use of Sophisticated Technology?
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Sophisticated technology displacing labour creates technological unemployment—machines substitute workers. Cyclical follows recessions; seasonal is harvest-linked; disguised is hidden underemployment in farms. You can eliminate A (Cyclical), C (Seasonal), D (Disguised) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
Development Financial Institutions were established to _______.
(a) provide short term funds
(b) develop industry, agriculture and other key sectors
(c) regulate the money market
(d) regulate the capital market
questions.explanation: Choose option C: Development Financial Institutions (IFCI, IDBI, NABARD lineage) were set up to finance long-term industrial/agricultural development—(b) only. Short-term money-market regulation is RBI/commercial banking territory. Distractors A (Only (a)), B ((a) and (b)), D ((d) and (c)) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) NABARD offers loans for agricultural sector development.
(b) NABARD provides loans to rural business.
(c) NABARD makes financial loans for the urban industries.
(d) NABARD provides financial support for urban development.
Which of the above statement/s are correct?
questions.explanation: (a) and (b) is the correct option here. NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) was set up on 12 July 1982 on the recommendation of the Sivaraman Committee to serve as the apex development bank for rural India. Read each statement independently and check it against a factual anchor (a date, a body, a percentage) before deciding — the option marked correct is the combination that survives the check. A helpful anchoring habit for questions of this type is to underline the year, proper noun or numeric anchor in the stem before you scan the options.

questions.text: Which of the following concept is related to the concept of "National Income"?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option C — National Income measures flow of goods/services over a period—flow concept. Stock is point-in-time; micro is method scope; 'none' ignores macro classification. You can eliminate A (Stock), B (Micro), D (None of the above) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: What is a balance budget?

options.A: Public revenue is less than public expenditure.
options.B: Public revenue is higher than public expenditure.
options.C: Public revenue and public expenditure are the same.

questions.explanation: Option C works here because Balanced budget means revenue equals expenditure—no deficit/surplus. Less spending than revenue is surplus; more is deficit—only exact equality defines balance. Distractors A (Public revenue is less than public expe…), B (Public revenue is higher than public ex…), D (None of the above.) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text:
Which are the founder countries of BRICS BANK?
(a) Brazil, Russia, India
(b) China, South Africa
(c) Japan, Germany, Switzerland
(d) Belgium, South Corea
questions.explanation: BRICS New Development Bank founders are Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa—(a) and (b) limbs. Japan/Germany/Switzerland and Belgium/South Korea are non-founding distractors.

questions.text:
Demographic transition is a result of _______.
(a) Changes in mortality
(b) Changes in fertility
(c) Changes in income distribution
(d) Urbanization
questions.explanation: The answer is option B: Demographic transition theory links falling mortality then fertility—(a) and (b) together drive stage shifts. Income distribution alone (c) is secondary; urbanization (d) accompanies but MT+FT pair is the textbook core. You can eliminate A ((a)), C ((a), (b) and (c)), D ((a), (b) and (d)) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Under which scheme free gas connections are given to poor women?
questions.explanation: This maps to "Ujjwala Yojana". Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (2016) provides free LPG connections to BPL women; over 10 crore connections issued through the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas. This is a classic MPSC 'anchor-word' item — the stem contains one specific term (a proper noun, a date, an article number) that maps directly to only one option.

questions.text: Who receives income from Income Tax?
questions.explanation: Income tax is levied and retained by the Central Government—Union list subject. States levy GST share, property, and agricultural taxes—not direct income tax.

questions.text: Which of the following schemes has not been introduced for reducing poverty in India?
questions.explanation: Option D is the right choice since Cultural Development Programme is not an anti-poverty scheme—EGS/MGNREGA lineage, JRY, and SJSRY/SSRY were poverty/wage-employment programmes. Culture ministry schemes don't target poverty reduction lists. You can eliminate A (Employment Guarantee Scheme), B (Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY)), C (Swarnajayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana (SS…) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: In which sector, India is suffering more due to "WTO"?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — india's WTO pain concentrated in TRIPs—patents, pharma, seeds, IP enforcement—more than culture/tourism/politics. Uruguay Round TRIPs compliance is the standard 'India suffering' exam narrative. Distractors A (Cultural Sector), B (Tourism Sector), C (Political Sector) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: Which of the following taxes is not the indirect tax in Indian Economy?
questions.explanation: Corporation tax is direct—levied on company profits, borne by entity. Sales tax, excise, and customs are indirect—passed to consumers. Corporation tax is the odd one out in indirect-tax lists.

questions.text: Who discovered radioactivity?
questions.explanation: Henri Becquerel discovered natural radioactivity in uranium salts (1896)—before Marie Curie's polonium/radium work. Rutherford probed nuclei; Einstein is relativity—Becquerel owns discovery credit.

questions.text: _______ are commonly used as rear view mirrors in vehicles.
questions.explanation: The answer is option D: Convex mirrors give wider field of view—used as vehicle rear-view mirrors (objects appear smaller, upright). Plane lacks spread; concave inverts and narrows; planoconvex is not the standard automotive choice. Distractors A (Planoconvex mirror), B (Plane mirror), C (Concave mirror) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Energy equivalent of mass 1 u is _______.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked 931 MeV as the correct response. The MPSC pattern for questions of this type is to plant one exact fact and three plausible-looking alternatives; the fact-based option is always the answer.

questions.text: Which of the following metal cannot be extracted from aqueous solution of its salt?
questions.explanation: Choose option A: Potassium is highly reactive—extracted by electrolysis of molten salts, not displacement from aqueous solution. Cu, Ag, Au sit below hydrogen and can be reduced from aqueous ions—K cannot. You can eliminate B (Cu), C (Ag), D (Au) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: _______ is an important ore of aluminium.
questions.explanation: Option B is the right choice since Cryolite (Na₃AlF₆) is a key aluminium ore/processing mineral—Hall–Héroult flux. Halite is salt; pyrolusite is manganese; chalcocite is copper—wrong metal pairings. Distractors A (Halite), C (Pyrolusite), D (Chalcocite) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: The set of the elements belonging to S-block is _______.
questions.explanation: Reading the stem carefully, the answer is Na, Ca, Ba, Ra. The safest way to lock this item into recall is to write the correct option next to its associated year or body in your revision notebook and skim it weekly.

questions.text: Which of the following set of terms is best applicable to Obelia?

options.D: Marine, Sedentary, Colonial, Polymorphic with true alternation of generation

questions.explanation: Option D works here because Obelia is marine, sedentary, colonial, polymorphic cnidarian showing true alternation of generations—full descriptor set (D). Partial lists drop polymorphism or alternation—incomplete taxonomy. You can eliminate A (Polymorphic, Colonial, Aquatic), B (Marine, Sedentary and Colonial), C (Marine, Sedentary, Polymorphic) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: The number of legs found in Peripatus is _______.
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Peripatus (Onychophora) bears 14–43 pairs of walking legs along its body—correct range. 10–15 or 10–20 undercount; 15–40 misstates upper bound in standard zoology texts. Distractors A (10 - 15 pairs), B (10 - 20 pairs), D (15 - 40 pairs) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Generic name of cockroach 'Periplaneta' was assigned by:
questions.explanation: Burmeister (1838) assigned generic name Periplaneta to cockroach—taxonomic history MCQ. Linnaeus dated earlier but different genera; de Beer and Bentham years/names are mismatched distractors.

questions.text: Which of the followings are known as Amphibians of plant kingdom?
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Bryophytes—mosses, liverworts—are 'amphibians of plant kingdom': land plants needing water for reproduction. Pteridophytes next step; gymnosperms/angiosperms are fully terrestrial seed plants. You can eliminate A (Pteridophytes), C (Gymnosperms), D (Angiosperms) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Insecticide poison the insect pests by affecting their _______.
questions.explanation: Organophosphate/carbamate insecticides block acetylcholinesterase—disrupt nervous system signalling in pests. Respiratory, muscular, or circulatory targets describe other poison classes, not primary neural mode.

questions.text:
Which of the following is correct statement/statements regarding inorganic nutrients in plants?
(a) N, S and Fe are macronutrients
(b) O, Ca and Mg are Micronutrients
(c) Cu, Zn and Mn are essential elements
(d) B, Mo and Cl are non-essential elements
questions.explanation: Macronutrients N, S, Fe (a) and essential micronutrients Cu, Zn, Mn (c) are correct pairings. (b) wrongly lists O, Ca, Mg as micronutrients—they are macronutrients; (d) wrongly calls B, Mo, Cl non-essential.

questions.text: West Nile Encephalitis (WNE) is the inflammation of the _______ caused by West Nile Virus. WNE was first diagnosed in the West Nile region of _______.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option A — West Nile Encephalitis inflames the brain (encephalitis); first identified in West Nile district, Uganda, 1937—(A). South Africa 1999 is a later US outbreak import; 'nervous system' is too broad versus encephalitis specificity. You can eliminate B (Brain, South Africa in 1999), C (Nervous system, Uganda in 1937), D (Nervous system, South Africa in 1999) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option A. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: White Button Mushrooms are scientifically (Biologically) named as _______.
questions.explanation: Option C works here because White button mushroom = Agaricus bisporus—global commercial table mushroom. Pleurotus is oyster; Volvariella is paddy straw; Eremothecium is a yeast—wrong species for button caps. Distractors A (Pleurotus florida), B (Volvariella volvaceae), D (Eremothecium ashbyi) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text: _______ hormone is released when water content of blood fluids is less than normal.
questions.explanation: Antidiuretic hormone vasopressin releases when blood osmolarity rises/dehydration—conserves water in kidneys. Renin–angiotensin is blood pressure; creatinine is waste marker—not the direct ADH trigger.

questions.text: If the letter group HJLN is coded as ILOR, then by the same principal what could be the correct code for the letter group DFHJ?
questions.explanation: Letter coding: H→I, J→L, L→O, N→R in HJLN→ILOR—each advances three steps in alphabet (H+3=I is +1 in some keys; paper uses alternate-position shift). Applying the same rule to DFHJ yields EHKN—option (B). FHJN and EGIL apply wrong step counts; FHIN breaks the J→K link.

questions.text:
Given below are 5 statements followed by options composed of 3 statements put together in a specific order. Choose the option that indicates logically valid argument. To be valid the 3rd statement of the composition should be the conclusion based on preceding 2 statements.
(a) Modern industry is research driven.
(b) 'Impro' is a modern industry.
(c) 'Impro' is research driven.
(d) 'Impro' may be research driven.
(e) Research driven industry is modern.
questions.explanation: Option B matches the question because Valid syllogism: 'Impro is modern industry (b)' + 'Modern industry is research driven (a)' ⇒ 'Impro is research driven (c)'—order (b),(a),(c). Reversing conclusion or using 'may be' weakens validity. Distractors A ((b), (e), (c)), C ((c), (a), (d)), D ((b), (d), (a)) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text:
Examine the following facts:
(a) Anu is heavier than Bano.
(b) Cynthia is taller than Dina.
(c) Bano is of same height as Dina but heavier than her.
(d) Dina is taller than Anu.
Select the correct conclusion based on above facts.

options.A: Cynthia is the heaviest and Anu is shortest of all.
options.B: Anu is definitely heaviest and shortest among all.
options.C: Cynthia is heaviest but it is impossible to conclude who is tallest of all.
options.D: It is impossible to draw conclusion about who is heaviest but Anu is definitely shortest among all.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is It is impossible to draw conclusion about who is heaviest but Anu is definitely shortest among all. The MPSC pattern for questions of this type is to plant one exact fact and three plausible-looking alternatives; the fact-based option is always the answer.

questions.text:
Total number of books that students A, B, C and D have is thirty. One of them has three books, another one is having six, third one is having nine and fourth one is having twelve books. B is having fewer books than C and D is having more books than A. If C has fewer books than D, then select the statement/s that/those is/are not necessarily true.
(a) A and B together must have at least 12 books.
(b) D and A together must have at least 15 books.
(c) C and D together must have at least 18 books.
(d) C and B together must have at least 9 books.
questions.explanation: Option D is the right choice since Books split 3,6,9,12 among A,B,C,D with B<C and D>A and C<D. Only statement (a)—A and B together ≥12—is not necessarily true; others follow from constraints. Key D = only (a) not necessarily true. You can eliminate A (All but (a)), B (All of the above), C (None of the above) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
The following is the information of Area and Population of States.
State A: Area 80,000 sq.km, Population 16 lakh
State B: Area 50,000 sq.km, Population 10 lakh
State C: Area 10,000 sq.km, Population 4 lakh
State D: Area 5,000 sq.km, Population 3 lakh
Which is the most thickly populated State?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is option D — Density = population/area: D has 3/5=0.6, C has 4/10=0.4, B and A have 0.2 and 0.2—State D (3000 people, 5000 km²) is densest despite largest area because population is high. Distractors A (A), B (B), C (C) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text:
10 workers working with same speed were deployed to construct a structure. 2 workers left on the 2nd day, another 2 left on the 3rd day and this went on till the work is completed. As a result 2 more days were needed to complete the work.
Select the number of days that were needed if 10 workers worked for all days.
questions.explanation: Let total work = 10D worker-days if 10 men finish in D days. Shrinking crew (10+8+6+…) finishes in D+2 days; solving the series equation gives D=3 days for the full-strength schedule. Options 4–5 overstate duration; 2 undercounts the worker-day balance.

questions.text: The price of sugar is increased by 60%. How much percent a householder should reduce the consumption of sugar so as not to increase the expenditure?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct because Price +60%; keep expenditure constant: consumption reduction = 60/(100+60) × 100 = 37.5%. Formula x/(100+x) for percent cut—25% and 30% under-cut; 40% over-cuts. You can eliminate A (25%), B (30%), D (40%) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. MPSC papers often recycle this type of detail, so read the question carefully before you commit to an option.

questions.text: Persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting on benches in the garden facing north. B is 40 m to the right of D, A is 60 m to the south of B. C is 50 m to the west of D, and E is 70 m to the north of A. Select most appropriate option that describes approximate minimum distance between C and E in metres.

options.A: It must be definitely greater than 90 m.
options.B: It must be definitely greater than 91 m but less than 92 m.
options.C: It must be definitely greater than 90 m but is less than 91 m.
options.D: It must be definitely less than 91 m.

questions.text: The denominator of a fraction is greater than the numerator by 5. If 8 is added to the numerator and 1 is subtracted from the denominator, the value of the fraction obtained is 15/11. The original fraction is _______.
questions.explanation: Let the numerator be n and denominator n+5. After adding 8 to the top and subtracting 1 from the bottom, (n+8)/(n+4)=15/11. Cross-multiply: 11n+88=15n+60, so 4n=28 and n=7. The original fraction is 7/12—option C. Distractors 3/8 and 11/15 is wrong the stated transformation; 1/6 breaks the 'denominator exceeds numerator by 5' constraint.

questions.text: The sum of the ages of a father and his son is 50 years. Four years ago, father's age was six times as that of his son. What are the present ages of the father and son respectively?

title: MPSC Subordinate Services Group B Pre 2021 (English)

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. The post of the Sarpanch (who is elected by the members of Gram Panchayat) or Upa Sarpanch, as the case may be, that has fallen vacant (due to resignation) shall be filled in within thirty days from the date of such vacancy.
b. The post of the directly elected Sarpanch that has fallen vacant shall be filled within three months from the date of such vacancy.
c. A member of a Gram Panchayat whose post has become vacant due to absence for continuous meetings of the Gram Panchayat shall not be eligible for re-election.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: Under the Maharashtra Gram Panchayat Act, when the Sarpanch or Upa Sarpanch elected by Gram Panchayat members resigns, the vacancy must be filled within thirty days—statement (a) captures that rule. Statement (b) misstates the timeline for a directly elected Sarpanch vacancy, and (c) wrongly denies re-election to a member who missed meetings; only (a) survives, not the bundled pairs.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements about the provisions of the Village Development Committees of Maharashtra Gram Panchayat Act :
a. The total number of members in a Village Development Committee shall not be less than seven and not more than seventeen.
b. Not less than one-third of its members shall be from amongst the members of the Gram Panchayat.
c. Not less than one-half of the members shall be women.
d. The Deputy Sarpanch shall be its ex-officio chairman.
e. Gram Sevak shall be its ex-officio member-secretary.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?

options.A: Only a, b, c and d
options.C: Only a, b, c and e

questions.explanation: The answer is option B: Village Development Committee composition in Maharashtra requires at least one-third members from the Gram Panchayat (b), at least half women (c), and the Gram Sevak as ex-officio member-secretary (e). The Deputy Sarpanch is not its ex-officio chairman, and the 7–17 member band alone does not complete the correct set—hence only b, c, and e. You can eliminate A (Only a, b, c and d), C (Only a, b, c and e), D (All of the above) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option B. questions.text: A neutron having energy of 0.025 eV is a/an _______.
questions.explanation: Neutrons near 0.025 eV at room temperature are thermal neutrons—equilibrated with moderator material for fission-chain reactions in reactors. Epithermal, fast, and generic 'slow' labels refer to higher-energy bands outside this canonical thermal energy window.

questions.explanation: Option C is correct because the second law forbids spontaneous heat flow from cold to hot, but a refrigerator or heat pump can transfer heat uphill by doing external work on the working fluid. questions.text: The minimum audible frequency of sound means
questions.explanation: Minimum audible frequency denotes the lower pitch limit of human hearing—the bottom end of the frequency range (~20 Hz), not threshold intensity (which is about loudness) or the upper pitch ceiling (~20 kHz). Confusing intensity with frequency is the usual acoustics trap.

questions.text: In Agriculture, groundwater is tapped by _______.
questions.explanation: Farmers tap groundwater through sinking/tube wells that pierce the water table—unlike canals, ponds, or surface tanks that store or convey surface water. Wells are the direct extraction technology for sub-surface aquifers in Indian agriculture.

questions.text: A devotee, while going to pray in the temple, put flowers on each step that indicated its number. When he offered 9 flowers to God, he had 17 flowers in balance. If the temple had 24 steps, then how many flowers did the devotee have ?

questions.text: Niraj's watch is fast by 5½ minutes in a day. Piyush's watch lags behind by 35 seconds per hour. If their watches indicated the same time at 8 o'clock in the morning, then by how many minutes would Neeraj's watch be ahead of Piyush's watch that night at 12 o'clock ?
questions.explanation: From 8 a.m. to midnight is 16 hours. Niraj gains 5½ min/day scaled to 16 h ≈ 3.67 min; Piyush loses 35 s/hour → 560 s ≈ 9.33 min over 16 h. Combined gap ≈ 13 minutes—Neeraj ahead. Using full-day gain without prorating or ignoring Piyush's lag yields 9, 10, or 14.

questions.explanation: On the 75th Independence Day eve peacetime gallantry Ashoka Chakra list, ASI Babu Ram (posthumous) was honoured—correct 'only a'. Constable Altaf Hussain, LG Murmu, and Mizoram Governor Pillai were not the Ashoka Chakra recipients in that specific announcement set.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. Kiwi is India's first certified organic fruit.
b. Arunachal Pradesh is the first State in the country to obtain an organic certification for its Kiwis.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: Choose option C: arunachal Pradesh pioneered organic certification for kiwi cultivation, and India treats kiwi as its first certified organic fruit in that policy narrative—both (a) and (b) stand together. Single-statement picks undercount the paired organic-fruit milestone. You can eliminate A (Only a), B (Only b), D (None of the above) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C. Keep the name, formula, and unit together in your notes — that helps you spot incomplete distractors quickly.

questions.text: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) (PMAY-U), as on 18th January, 2021 _______ houses have been sanctioned.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked 109.2 Lakhs as the correct response. Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana provides pucca housing (PMAY-Gramin under MoRD; PMAY-Urban under MoHUA); target: Housing for All by 2024. This exact fact has appeared in earlier MPSC prelims — practising the wording of the correct option is worth two to three easy marks per paper.

questions.text: In which year did Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth and Mohana Singh create history by becoming the first women pilots to be commissioned into the fighter stream of Indian Air Force ?
questions.explanation: Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth, and Mohana Singh were commissioned as India's first women fighter pilots in 2016—entering the IAF combat stream after Stage-II training. 2015, 2017, and 2018 are adjacent but not the commissioning year.

questions.text: Which Space agency has launched the first all-electric experimental aircraft 'X-57 Maxwell' ?
questions.explanation: Option D works here because NASA's all-electric experimental aircraft X-57 Maxwell tests distributed electric propulsion—part of the agency's green aviation research. ISRO, CNES, and LAPAN operate other programmes but did not launch this Maxwell demonstrator. You can eliminate A (LAPAN), B (ISRO), C (CNES) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

questions.text: Which artificial satellite was launched by India on 11th December, 2019 through PSLV – C48 launcher ?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct because PSLV-C48 on 11 December 2019 placed RISAT-2BR1 among its payload complement—radar imaging satellite for earth observation. EMISAT, Cartosat-2B, and GSAT-31 flew on other missions/dates in the ISRO launch manifest. Distractors B (EMISAT), C (CARTOSAT – 2B), D (GSAT – 31) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. Store the reasoning behind the answer, not just the letter, because topic packs revisit the same idea in different forms.

questions.text:
खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
अ. सरपंचावे (ज्याची निवड ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सभासदांकडून झालेली आहे) अथवा उपसरपंचावे, रिक्त (राजीनामामुळे) झालेले पद ते रिक्त झाल्याच्या दिनांका पासून तीस दिवसांच्या आत भरले पाहिजे.
ब. थेट जनतेमार्फत निवडलेल्या सरपंचावे रिक्त झालेले पद ते रिक्त झाल्याच्या दिनांका पासून तीन महिन्यांच्या आत भरले पाहिजे.
क. ग्राम पंचायतीच्या ज्या सदस्याचे पद सतत ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सभेला गैरहजर राहण्याच्या कारणास्तव रिकामे झाले असेल तर तो लगेच पुन्हा निवडून येण्यास पात्र नसतो.
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A (फक्त अ) — (b) directly elected सरपंच vacancy कालरेषा चुकीचा; (c) meetings चुक केल्यामुळे re-निवडणूक deny करतो — चुकीचे. फक्त (a) survive; bundled जोडीs नाहीत. पर्याय B (फक्त अ आणि क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (फक्त ब आणि क) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (अ, ब आणि क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्र ग्राम पंचायत अधिनियमातील 'ग्राम विकास समित्या' संबंधीच्या तरतुदी बाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
अ. ग्राम विकास समितीतील सदस्यांची एकूण संख्या सातपेक्षा कमी नसेल आणि सतरा पेक्षा जास्त नसेल.
ब. ग्राम विकास समितीतील सदस्यांपैकी एकूतीयांशापेक्षा कमी नसतील इतके सदस्य ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सदस्यांमधील असतील.
क. तिच्या सदस्यांपैकी एक द्वितीयांशापेक्षा कमी नसतील इतके सदस्य महिला असतील.
ड. उप सरपंच हा तिचा पदसिद्ध अध्यक्ष असेल.
ई. ग्रामसेवक हा तिचा पदसिद्ध सदस्य-सचिव असेल.
वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने योग्य आहेत ?

options.A: फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ड
options.C: फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ई

questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो। Village विकास समिती composition Maharashtra: किमान one-तिसरा Gram Panchayat members (b), किमान half women (c), Gram Sevak ex-officio member-secretary (e)। Deputy सरपंच ex-officio chairman नाही; 7–17 member band alone योग्य set complete नाही — म्हणून b, c, e। पर्याय A (फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ई) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (वरील सर्व) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: 'सरकारिया आयोग' _________ यासाठी अनुकूल होते.
questions.explanation: संविधानात हे लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय D (वरीलपैकी एकही नाही) बरोबर. सरकारिया आयोग (१९८३) केंद्र–राज्य संबंध संतुलित करण्यासाठी होता; राज्यपाल पद, अखिल भारतीय सेवा किंवा आंतर-राज्य परिषद रद्द करण्याची शिफारस नाही — ती संघाची रचना सुधारण्याची होती, रद्द करण्याची नाही।

questions.text: राज्याच्या महाधिवक्त्यासंबंधी खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे ?

options.A: तो राज्याच्या मंत्री परिषदेची इच्छा असेपर्यंत आपल्या पदावर राहू शकतो.
options.B: त्याचे मानधन राज्य विधिमंडळाद्वारे निश्चित केले जाते.
options.C: तो राज्यशासना विरुद्ध असलेल्या खटल्यात खाजगी पक्षकारासाठी वकील म्हणून उभा राहू शकतो.

questions.explanation: प्रश्नातील विधाने तपासल्यास पर्याय D बरोबर आहे. कलम 165 + practice: Advocate General राज्यपाल's — Council of Ministers alone नाही; remuneration राज्यपाल fix, Legislature नाही; करू शकत नाही. प्रत्येक standalone पर्याय limb चुक — 'वरीलपैकी कोणतेही नाही' बरोबर।

questions.text:
विधान (अ) : संसदीय पद्धतीमध्ये प्रशासनावरील कायदेमंडळाचे नियंत्रण अध्यक्षीय पद्धतीपेक्षा भिन्न असते.
कारण (ब) : प्रशासनावर कायदेमंडळाचे नियंत्रण हे लोकसत्ताक शासनाचे महत्त्वाचे वैशिष्ट्य आहे.

options.A: 'अ' आणि 'ब' दोन्हीही बरोबर आणि 'ब' हे 'अ' चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण आहे.
options.B: 'अ' आणि 'ब' दोन्हीही बरोबर, परंतु 'ब' हे 'अ' चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण नाही.
options.C: 'अ' हे बरोबर आहे, परंतु 'ब' हे चुकीचे आहे.
options.D: 'अ' हे चुकीचे आहे, परंतु 'ब' हे बरोबर आहे.

questions.explanation: प्रश्नातील विधाने तपासल्यास पर्याय B बरोबर आहे. कारण (B) बरोबर — democratic सरकार — पण general principle two नाही. दोन्ही बरोबर, B A चे explanation नाही MPSC प्रश्नपत्रिकेत अशा तपशीलांची पुनरावृत्ती होते, म्हणून मुख्य संकल्पना लक्षात ठेवा.।

questions.text:
'अर्थ विधेयका' बाबतीत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
अ. ते मंत्री किंवा खाजगी सदस्य मांडू शकतो.
ब. ते राज्यपालांच्या शिफारशी शिवाय मांडता येत नाही.
क. एखादे विधेयक अर्थ विधेयक आहे किंवा नाही असा प्रश्न उपस्थित झाल्यास राज्यपालांचा अंतिम निर्णय असतो.
ड. जर दोन्ही सभागृहांमध्ये अर्थ विधेयका बाबत पेच निर्माण झाल्यास राज्यपाल विधानसभा आणि विधान परिषदेची संयुक्त बैठक बोलावू शकतात.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (फक्त ब) — खासगी सदस्य धन विधेयके introduce करू शकत नाहीत (a चुकी); money-bill disputes Speaker decide, राज्यपाल नाही (c चुकी); राज्यपाल-summoned joint sitting deadlock device कलम 108 राष्ट्रपती सारखे नाही (d चुकी)। पर्याय A (फक्त अ आणि ब) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त अ, ब आणि क) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (फक्त अ, क आणि ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात।

questions.text: भारतीय संसदेला राज्यसूचीतील कोणत्याही विषयाबाबत राष्ट्रीय हितासाठी कायदा करण्याचा अधिकार आहे जर तसंबंधी _________ ने ठराव मंजूर केला तर.

options.A: लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या बहुमताने
options.B: लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या दोन-तृतीयांश पेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या बहुमताने
options.C: राज्यसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या बहुमताने
options.D: राज्यसभेने हजर राहून मतदान करणाऱ्या दोन-तृतीयांश सदस्य संख्येपेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या बहुमताने

questions.explanation: पर्याय D (राज्यसभेने हजर राहून मतदान करणाऱ्या दोन…) — कलम 249 empowers संसद to legislate on State List subjects in national interest when the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution by नाही less than two-thirds of members present and voting—हे simple Lok Sabha majority or a Rajya Sabha majority of total membership. The two-thirds present-and-voting threshold in the Council of States is the statutory gate पर्याय A (लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या ब…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या द…) प्रश्नातील तथ्ये/गणना/व्याख्येशी विरोधाभासी आहे; पर्याय C (राज्यसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्राच्या संदर्भात खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
अ. जिल्हा परिषदेची बैठक जेंव्हा आवश्यक असेल तेंव्हा भरविता येईल परंतु मागील बैठक आणि पुढील बैठकीच्या तारखेत एक महि-न्यापेक्षा जास्त अंतर नसावे.
ब. जिल्हा परिषद अध्यक्ष एक-पंचमांश पेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या सदस्यांच्या लेखी विनंतीनुसार विशेष बैठक बोलावू शकतात.
क. प्रत्येक बैठकीचे अध्यक्षस्थान-अध्यक्षाने आणि त्याच्या अनुपस्थिती मध्ये उपाध्यक्षाने भूषविले पाहिजे.
ड. अध्यक्ष आणि उपाध्यक्ष यांच्या अनुपस्थिती मध्ये बैठकीचे अध्यक्षस्थान विषय समितीचा सभापती भूषवील.
वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
questions.explanation: MPSC ने हा प्रश्न परीक्षा प्राधिकरणाने रद्द केला आहे — अधिकृत निकालात कोणत्याही पर्यायाला गुण मिळत नाहीत. स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ कीचा संदर्भ ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही MPSC ने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला; स्व-अभ्यासासाठी पर्याय A। स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ तर्क ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही. पर्याय B (फक्त ब, क आणि ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त ब आणि क) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (वरील सर्व) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: सर्वसाधारणपणे, राज्याच्या उच्च न्यायालयामध्ये मुख्य न्यायाधीश आणि _________ समावेश असतो.
questions.explanation: प्रश्नाची अपेक्षा राष्ट्रपती ठरविल इतके इतर न्यायाधीशांचा या पर्यायात पूर्ण होते. भारतात 2026 पर्यंत 25 उच्च न्यायालये आहेत; सर्वात जुने कोलकाता उच्च न्यायालय (1862) असून त्यानंतर मुंबई व मद्रास उच्च न्यायालये आहेत. भारताचे राष्ट्रपती हे राज्यप्रमुख असून त्यांची निवडणूक एकल हस्तांतरणीय मत पद्धतीने अप्रत्यक्षपणे केली जाते. MPSC ची पद्धत — प्रश्नात एक निश्चित तथ्य ठेवायचे व तीन जवळचे भासणारे पर्याय ठेवायचे — तथ्याशी जुळणारा पर्याय नेहमीच बरोबर असतो.

questions.explanation: Among Constituent Assembly committees, Dr Rajendra Prasad chaired the Rules of Procedure समिती—organising debate and procedural order during संविधान-making. Ambedkar led drafting; Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar and K M Munshi held other समिती roles but नाही this specific chairmanship पर्याय A (डॉ. आंबेडकर) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (अल्लादी कृष्णस्वामी अय्यर) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (डॉ. मुन्शी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: दादाभाई नौरोजीच्या मते, '_________ चे निःसारण होते, परंतु तेच जर भारात गुंतवले असते, तर मोठ्या प्रमाणात आर्थिक विकास पहावयास मिळाला असता.' गाळलेल्या जागा खालीलपैकी योग्य पर्यायाने भरा.
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. अर्थशास्त्रात हे लक्षात ठेवा — दादाभाई नौरोजी drain theory: 'संभाव्य अधिशेष' (potential surplus) Britain कडे जातो; भारतात गुंतवले असते तर विकास. हस्तकला, चलन, संपूर्ण कापूस अधिक संकुचित — पर्याय D।

questions.text:

वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
questions.explanation: प्रश्नातील विधाने तपासल्यास पर्याय C (फक्त ब, क आणि ड) बरोबर. ब्रिटिश काळात निर्यातोन्मुख व्यापारी शेतीमुळे ऊस-कापूस, ताग-नीळ, तंबाखू-अफू यांचे उत्पादन वाढले. चहा-गहू (अ) ही जोडी या निर्यातीकरणाच्या मुख्य पिकांशी जुळत नाही; 'वरील सर्व' (D) चuकiche।

questions.text: पंडिता रमाबाईंना ब्रिटिश सरकारने कोणता किताब दिला होता ?
questions.explanation: 'Kaisar-e-Hindu', 'Kaisar-e-Lady', 'Indian Super Lady' बनावट/चुकीची variants — पर्याय A। पर्याय B (कैसर-ए-हिंदू) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (कैसर-ए-लेडी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (इंडियन सुपर लेडी) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
आदीवासी शेतकऱ्यांच्या क्रांतीचा पहिला नायक कोण होता ?
अ. बाबा भांड    ब. बिजनिया    क. कजर सिंग    ड. तंट्या भिल्ल
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/विधाने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
questions.explanation: पर्याय D (फक्त ड) — पर्याय A (फक्त अ आणि ब) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय B (फक्त क आणि ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त ब) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात।

questions.text: नागरी उठावांची सुरुवात खालीलपैकी कोणत्या प्रदेशांतून झाली ?
questions.explanation: इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — पर्याय D बरोबर आहे. इतिहासात हे लक्षात ठेवा — 1857 च्या सैन्य उठावानंतर ब्रिटिश महसूल व न्यायव्यवस्थेच्या हस्तक्षेपामुळे नागरी उठावांची लाट बंगाल व बिहार या पूर्वी भागातून सुरू झाली; संताल, नील उत्पादन व शेतकरी आंदोलने येथे प्रमुख. पंजाब-सिंध, महाराष्ट्र-कर्नाटक किंवा आंध्र-ओरिसा जोडी ही सुरुवातीची भूगोल नाही — पर्याय D।

questions.text:
खालील विवरणावरून स्त्री मुक्तीसाठी कोणी कार्य केले, ते ओळखा :
अ. 'शारदा' या लोकप्रिय नाटकात बालविवाहाचा प्रश्न मांडला.
ब. हंटर कमिशनपुढे स्त्री शिक्षणाची स्थिती आकडेवारीसह प्रभावीपणे मांडली.
क. विधवा स्त्रीयांच्यासाठी 'शारदाश्रम' ही संस्था स्थापन केली.
ड. 'माझे पुराण' हे आत्मचरित्र लिहिले.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :

options.A: अ-पंडिता रमाबाई, ब-गोविंद बल्लाळ, क-आनंदीबाई कर्वे, ड-रमाबाई रानडे
options.B: अ-रमाबाई रानडे, ब-आनंदीबाई कर्वे, क-पंडिता रमाबाई, ड-गोविंद बल्लाळ
options.C: अ-विद्याबेन निळकंठ, ब-रमाबाई रानडे, क-आनंदीबाई कर्वे, ड-गोविंद बल्लाळ
options.D: अ-गोविंद बल्लाळ, ब-पंडिता रमाबाई, क-रमाबाई रानडे, ड-आनंदीबाई कर्वे

questions.explanation: MPSC ने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला; स्व-अभ्यासासाठी पर्याय A. MPSC ने हा प्रश्न परीक्षा प्राधिकरणाने रद्द केला आहे — अधिकृत निकालात कोणत्याही पर्यायाला गुण मिळत नाहीत. स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ तर्क ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही पर्याय B (अ-रमाबाई रानडे, ब-आनंदीबाई कर्वे, क-पंड…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (अ-विद्याबेन निळकंठ, ब-रमाबाई रानडे, क-आ…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (अ-गोविंद बल्लाळ, ब-पंडिता रमाबाई, क-रमा…) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
1857 च्या उठावाविषयी खालीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
अ. भोरचे पंतसचिव चिमणाजी रघुनाथ (प्रथम) यांनी रंगो बापूजी गुप्ते यांना विश्वासघाताने इंग्रजांच्या हवाली केले.
ब. नागपूरच्या भोसले घराण्यातील राणी बाकाबाई यांनी बंडवाल्यांना पाठिंबा दिला.
क. कोल्हापूरच्या छत्रपतीच्या घराण्यातील चिमासाहेब उठावात सामील झाले.
ड. रंगो बापूजी गुप्तेचे चिरंजीव सीतारामपंत व सावंतवाडीचे रामजी शिरसाळ यांनीही उठाव केला.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: नागपूरच्या राणी बाकाबाई यांनी बंडवाल्यांना पाठिंबा दिला नाही (ब) — म्हणून अ, क, ड — पर्याय C। पर्याय A (फक्त अ आणि क) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय B (फक्त ब, क आणि ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय D (फक्त क आणि ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात।

questions.text: भारतातील सर्वात लांब राष्ट्रीय महामार्ग _________ आहे.
questions.explanation: परीक्षेनुसार पर्याय A बरोबर आहे. भूगोलात हे स्थिर — भारतातील सर्वात लांब राष्ट्रीय महामार्ग NH 44 आहे; जुने क्रमांक NH 7, श्रीनगर ते कन्याकुमारी सुमारे ४००० किमी। NH 01, NH 48, NH 06 महत्त्वाचे मार्ग असले तरी लांबीच्या तुलनेत NH 44 प्रथम — पर्याय A।

questions.text:
औद्योगिक विभाग आणि औद्योगिक क्षेत्र यांच्या जोड्या लावा :
अ. नाशिक          I. बुटीबोरी
ब. कोल्हापूर        II. शेंद्रा
क. नागपूर          III. विंचूर
ड. औरंगाबाद      IV. हुपरी
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: महाराष्ट्रातील औद्योगिक क्षेत्रांची जोडी लक्षात ठेवा — नाशिक-विंचूर (III), कोल्हापूर-हुपरी (IV), नागपूर-बुटीबोरी (I), औरंगाबाद-शेंद्रा (II)। MIDC/औद्योगिक नोड्स ही जोडी D: अ-III, ब-IV, क-I, ड-II — इतर पर्याय नागपूर-शेंद्रा किंवa औरंगाबाद-बुटीबोरी अदलाबदल करतात. पर्याय A (अ-IV, ब-III, क-II, ड-I) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय B (अ-III, ब-I, क-II, ड-IV) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी; पर्याय C (अ-III, ब-I, क-IV, ड-II) मध्ये किमान एक जोडी चुकीच्या क्रमाने मांडली आहे, म्हणून ती वर्गातून वगळावी।

questions.text:
औरंगाबाद औद्योगिक शहराची ठळक वैशिष्ट्ये :
अ. सुनियोजित आणि हरितपट्टेयुक्त स्मार्ट शहर.
ब. AURIC हे संक्षिप्त रूप आहे.
क. प्रकल्पातील एकुण गुंतवणूक 1,000 कोटी रुपये.
ड. दिल्ली-मुंबई औद्योगिक पट्ट्याचा (कॉरिडॉरचा) भाग आहे.
अचूक पर्याय निवडा :
questions.explanation: गणितात हे सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो। AURIC: smart greenfield (a), संक्षिप्त नाव (b), DMIC (d) — बरोबर। (c) एकूण गुंतवणूक नक्की ₹1,000 कोटी अधिकृत briefs understatement — a, b, d; क वगळून D। पर्याय A (फक्त अ) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय B (फक्त अ आणि ब) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त अ, ब आणि क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: सन 1981 ते 2011 या कालावधीतील भारतीय लोकसंख्या वाढ आणि काल सापेक्ष बदल कोणती लोकसंख्या संक्रमण अवस्था दर्शविते ?

options.A: उच्च लोकसंख्या वाढीचा कालावधी, तरीही घटता कल

questions.explanation: प्रश्नाची अपेक्षा उच्च लोकसंख्या वाढीचा कालावधी, तरीही घटता कल या पर्यायात पूर्ण होते. प्रश्नात 1981 या वर्षाचा उल्लेख असून हे उत्तर त्या कालावधीशी जुळते. MPSC ची पद्धत — प्रश्नात एक निश्चित तथ्य ठेवायचे व तीन जवळचे भासणारे पर्याय ठेवायचे — तथ्याशी जुळणारा पर्याय नेहमीच बरोबर असतो.

questions.text: भारतीय मूलभूत रस्ते सांख्यिकी, 2017 नुसार भारतातील कोणते राज्य राष्ट्रीय महामार्गाच्या लांबीमध्ये दुसऱ्या क्रमांकाचे राज्य आहे ?
questions.explanation: राजस्थान, मध्य प्रदेश, महाराष्ट्र महत्त्वाचे, पण 2017 अहवालात UP दुसरा — पर्याय D। पर्याय A (महाराष्ट्र) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय B (राजस्थान) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (मध्य प्रदेश) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणता प्रदेश भारतातील उच्च भूकंप तीव्रता विभाग दर्शवितो ?
questions.explanation: पर्याय B (काश्मिर ते आसामपर्यंतचा हिमालयीन विभाग) — पर्याय A (द्विपकल्पीय विभाग) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (मध्य विभाग) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (गंगेचे मैदान) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

questions.text:
2011 च्या जनगणनेप्रमाणे महाराष्ट्रातील नागरीकरणाबाबत कोणते/कोणती वाक्य चुकीचे आहे/आहेत ?
अ. नागरी लोकसंख्येची टक्केवारी 45·23 आहे.
ब. महाराष्ट्राचा नागरी लोकसंख्येत तिसरा क्रमांक लागतो.

ड. महाराष्ट्रातील नंदूरबार जिल्ह्याची नागरीकरणाची पातळी सर्वात कमी आहे.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: MPSC ने हा प्रश्न परीक्षा प्राधिकरणाने रद्द केला आहे — अधिकृत निकालात कोणत्याही पर्यायाला गुण मिळत नाहीत. स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ कीचा संदर्भ ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही MPSC ने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला; स्व-अभ्यासासाठी पर्याय A। स्व-अभ्यासासाठी मूळ तर्क ठेवता येतो, पण गुणांकनात हा प्रश्न विचारात घेतला जात नाही. पर्याय B (फक्त क) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात; पर्याय C (फक्त अ आणि क) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (फक्त ड) मध्ये फक्त काही विधाने घेतली आहेत, पण प्रश्नातील सर्व बरोबर विधाने एकत्र येतात।

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्रातील जलसिंचन योजना व त्यांचे जिल्हे यांच्या योग्य जोड्या लावा :
       जिल्हा        जलसिंचन योजना
अ. सातारा          I. मुकणे
ब. नाशिक          II. विष्णुपुरी
क. नांदेड          III. कण्हेर
